ko.title: 휴전 1년 후: 미·중 무역 데탕트의 쟁점은 무엇인가

segments.src: When President Donald Trump and President Xi Jinping met in Busan, South Korea, on October 30, 2025, the two sides agreed to a one-year pause in several of their sharpest trade measures.
segments.tr: 2025년 10월 30일 대한민국 부산에서 도널드 트럼프 대통령과 시진핑 주석이 만났을 때, 양측은 가장 날카로운 무역 조치 몇 가지를 1년간 유예하기로 합의했습니다.

segments.src: The arrangement took effect in November 2025.
segments.tr: 이 합의는 2025년 11월부터 발효되었습니다.

segments.src: Now that the first anniversary has passed, attention has turned to a simple question: **will the pause be extended, reshaped, or allowed to lapse?**
segments.tr: 1주년이 지난 지금, 관심은 단순한 질문으로 쏠리고 있습니다: **이 유예 조치가 연장될 것인가, 재편될 것인가, 아니면 만료되도록 둘 것인가?**

segments.src: This article summarizes what the truce covered, what each side has done under it, which issues remain open, and how different outcomes could affect prices and supply chains.
segments.tr: 이 기사는 휴전의 내용, 각 측이 그동안 취한 조치, 여전히 해결되지 않은 문제, 그리고 다양한 결과가 가격과 공급망에 미칠 영향에 대해 요약합니다.

segments.src: Trade policy changes quickly, so check official announcements for the latest status.
segments.tr: 무역 정책은 빠르게 변하므로 최신 상태는 공식 발표를 확인하십시오.

segments.src: ## Why the truce mattered
segments.tr: ## 휴전이 중요했던 이유

segments.src: Through 2025, tariffs and export restrictions between the world's two largest economies escalated in steps.
segments.tr: 2025년 내내 세계 양대 경제국 간의 관세와 수출 제한 조치는 단계적으로 확대되었습니다.

segments.src: Tariff rates on many goods climbed to levels that analysts warned could effectively halt trade in affected categories.
segments.tr: 많은 품목에 대한 관세율은 분석가들이 해당 범주의 무역을 사실상 중단시킬 수 있다고 경고하는 수준까지 치솟았습니다.

segments.src: China also announced broader controls on rare-earth materials and related technologies, which are essential to magnets used in electric vehicles, wind turbines, electronics and defense equipment.
segments.tr: 중국은 또한 전기차, 풍력 터빈, 전자제품 및 방산 장비에 사용되는 자석의 필수 재료인 희토류와 관련 기술에 대한 광범위한 통제를 발표했습니다.

segments.src: The Busan arrangement did not resolve the underlying disagreements.
segments.tr: 부산 합의는 근본적인 이견을 해결하지는 못했습니다.

segments.src: It lowered the temperature, giving businesses a more predictable window for planning.
segments.tr: 하지만 긴장을 완화하여 기업들에게 계획을 세울 수 있는 보다 예측 가능한 기간을 제공했습니다.

segments.src: That predictability is the main thing at stake now.
segments.tr: 그 예측 가능성이 현재 가장 중요한 쟁점입니다.

segments.src: ## What the truce covered
segments.tr: ## 휴전의 내용

segments.src: The main elements, as announced by both governments in late 2025, were:
segments.tr: 2025년 말 양국 정부가 발표한 주요 내용은 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: - **Tariffs.** The United States reduced the so-called fentanyl-related tariff on Chinese goods from 20% to 10% and extended a suspension of higher reciprocal tariff rates. Existing tariffs from earlier years, including Section 301 duties, largely remained in place.
segments.tr: - **관세.** 미국은 중국산 제품에 대한 이른바 펜타닐 관련 관세를 20%에서 10%로 인하하고, 더 높은 상호 관세율의 적용 유예를 연장했습니다. 301조 관세를 포함한 이전의 기존 관세는 대부분 그대로 유지되었습니다.

segments.src: - **Rare earths.** China agreed to suspend the sweeping export-control measures it announced in October 2025 and to issue general licenses for certain materials. Earlier licensing requirements introduced in April 2025 stayed in force, so the system was eased rather than removed.
segments.tr: - **희토류.** 중국은 2025년 10월에 발표한 광범위한 수출 통제 조치를 유예하고 특정 재료에 대한 일반 라이선스를 발급하기로 합의했습니다. 2025년 4월에 도입된 이전의 라이선스 요건은 그대로 유지되었으므로, 시스템이 완전히 제거된 것이 아니라 완화된 것입니다.

segments.src: - **Agricultural purchases.** China committed to resume large-scale purchases of U.S. soybeans, with a stated target of about 12 million metric tons in late 2025 and 25 million metric tons annually in the following years.
segments.tr: - **농산물 구매.** 중국은 미국산 대두에 대한 대규모 구매를 재개하기로 약속했으며, 2025년 말 약 1,200만 톤, 이후 매년 2,500만 톤을 목표로 설정했습니다.

segments.src: - **Other pauses.** Both sides suspended some recently introduced measures, including certain port fees on ships and a U.S. rule that would have extended export restrictions to subsidiaries of listed companies.
segments.tr: - **기타 유예 조치.** 양측은 최근 도입된 일부 조치를 유예했는데, 여기에는 선박에 대한 특정 항만 수수료와 상장 기업의 자회사까지 수출 제한을 확대하려던 미국의 규정이 포함됩니다.

segments.src: ## What each side has delivered
segments.tr: ## 각 측의 이행 상황

segments.src: Assessing compliance is harder than it sounds, because the commitments were described in general terms and verification relies on trade data that is published with a delay.
segments.tr: 약속이 일반적인 용어로 기술되었고 검증은 지연되어 발표되는 무역 데이터에 의존하기 때문에, 준수 여부를 평가하는 것은 생각보다 어렵습니다.

segments.src: **On soybeans,** the key metrics are monthly customs data and U.S.
segments.tr: **대두의 경우,** 핵심 지표는 월간 관세 데이터와 미국

segments.src: Department of Agriculture export reports.
segments.tr: 농무부의 수출 보고서입니다.

segments.src: Purchases are typically made by state-linked buyers, and timing follows seasonal patterns: the U.S.
segments.tr: 구매는 일반적으로 국가와 연계된 구매자가 수행하며, 시기는 계절적 패턴을 따릅니다: 미국

segments.src: harvest and export season runs mainly from autumn through winter, while Brazil dominates Chinese imports in the first half of the year.
segments.tr: 수확 및 수출 시즌은 주로 가을부터 겨울까지 이어지는 반면, 상반기 중국 수입 시장은 브라질이 주도합니다.

segments.src: Because of that seasonality, a full-year tally is more meaningful than any single month.
segments.tr: 이러한 계절성 때문에 단일 월 데이터보다는 연간 총계가 더 의미가 있습니다.

segments.src: Analysts have also noted that the 25-million-ton annual figure is below the volumes China bought from the United States in the years before the trade war, so meeting it would be a partial recovery, not a return to the old baseline.
segments.tr: 분석가들은 또한 연간 2,500만 톤이라는 수치가 무역 전쟁 이전 몇 년간 중국이 미국으로부터 구매했던 물량보다 적기 때문에, 이를 달성하더라도 이전의 기준점으로 완전히 돌아가는 것이 아니라 부분적인 회복에 그칠 것이라고 지적했습니다.

segments.src: **On rare earths,** the practical test is whether exporters can obtain licenses reliably and quickly.
segments.tr: **희토류의 경우,** 실질적인 시험대는 수출업체가 라이선스를 안정적이고 신속하게 취득할 수 있는지 여부입니다.

segments.src: Companies in automotive and electronics supply chains have reported that approvals and delivery times matter as much as the formal rules.
segments.tr: 자동차 및 전자제품 공급망에 있는 기업들은 승인 및 납기 시간이 공식적인 규칙만큼이나 중요하다고 보고했습니다.

segments.src: Even with general licenses, China retains the ability to slow or tighten approvals, which is why many manufacturers continue to look for alternative sources.
segments.tr: 일반 라이선스가 있더라도 중국은 여전히 승인을 늦추거나 강화할 수 있는 능력을 보유하고 있으며, 이것이 많은 제조업체가 계속해서 대체 공급원을 찾는 이유입니다.

segments.src: **On tariffs,** the United States has kept the reduced rates in place during the truce period, though other tariff actions, including sector-specific measures and legal challenges to the use of emergency powers for tariffs, have continued to shape the broader picture.
segments.tr: **관세의 경우,** 미국은 휴전 기간 동안 인하된 관세율을 유지해 왔지만, 부문별 조치 및 관세를 위한 비상 권한 사용에 대한 법적 문제를 포함한 다른 관세 조치들이 계속해서 더 큰 그림을 형성하고 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What remains unresolved
segments.tr: ## 해결되지 않은 과제

segments.src: Several issues were deliberately left for later:
segments.tr: 몇 가지 문제는 의도적으로 나중으로 미뤄졌습니다:

segments.src: 1. **Technology controls.** Restrictions on advanced semiconductors and chipmaking equipment remain a central point of friction. Each side's decisions in this area can trigger responses elsewhere.
segments.tr: 1. **기술 통제.** 첨단 반도체 및 칩 제조 장비에 대한 제한은 여전히 갈등의 핵심 지점입니다. 이 분야에서 양측의 결정은 다른 곳에서 대응을 유발할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 2. **Structural concerns.** U.S. officials continue to raise questions about industrial subsidies, overcapacity and market access. Chinese officials point to U.S. tariffs and export restrictions as barriers to normal trade.
segments.tr: 2. **구조적 우려.** 미국 관리들은 산업 보조금, 과잉 생산, 시장 접근성에 대해 계속해서 문제를 제기하고 있습니다. 중국 관리들은 미국의 관세와 수출 제한을 정상적인 무역의 장벽으로 지적합니다.

segments.src: 3. **Legal uncertainty.** Court rulings on the authority behind some U.S. tariffs could change the tools available to the administration, even if the political deal holds.
segments.tr: 3. **법적 불확실성.** 일부 미국 관세의 근거가 되는 권한에 대한 법원 판결은 정치적 합의가 유지되더라도 행정부가 사용할 수 있는 도구를 바꿀 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 4. **Durability.** A one-year arrangement invites a recurring cliff. Companies must decide whether to treat the current rates as a stable base or as a temporary window.
segments.tr: 4. **지속 가능성.** 1년짜리 합의는 반복적인 절벽을 초래합니다. 기업들은 현재의 관세율을 안정적인 기반으로 볼지, 아니면 일시적인 창구로 볼지 결정해야 합니다.

segments.src: ## Scenarios: extension, breakdown or something in between
segments.tr: ## 시나리오: 연장, 결렬, 또는 그 사이의 무언가

segments.src: **Extension or a broader follow-up deal.** If both governments prolong the pause, the most likely effect is continuity: current tariff levels stay roughly in place, rare-earth licensing continues, and importers keep planning around today's costs.
segments.tr: **연장 또는 더 광범위한 후속 합의.** 양국 정부가 유예를 연장한다면, 가장 가능성 높은 효과는 연속성입니다: 현재의 관세 수준이 대체로 유지되고, 희토류 라이선스 발급이 계속되며, 수입업체들은 현재의 비용을 기준으로 계획을 세울 것입니다.

segments.src: A longer horizon would make it easier for businesses to commit to inventory and sourcing decisions, though it would not erase the tariffs that already exist.
segments.tr: 더 긴 기간은 기업들이 재고 및 소싱 결정을 내리는 것을 더 쉽게 만들겠지만, 이미 존재하는 관세를 없애지는 못할 것입니다.

segments.src: **Partial lapse or selective tightening.** A middle path could involve some measures returning while others are kept in place.
segments.tr: **부분적 만료 또는 선택적 강화.** 중간 경로는 일부 조치는 복귀시키고 다른 조치는 유지하는 방식일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: This would likely produce uneven effects across industries.
segments.tr: 이는 산업 전반에 걸쳐 고르지 않은 영향을 미칠 가능성이 높습니다.

segments.src: Sectors reliant on rare-earth inputs or on specific agricultural exports would be especially sensitive.
segments.tr: 희토류 투입재나 특정 농산물 수출에 의존하는 부문이 특히 민감할 것입니다.

segments.src: **Breakdown.** If suspended measures snapped back, the effects would likely appear first in sentiment and shipping decisions, then in prices.
segments.tr: **결렬.** 유예된 조치가 다시 시행된다면, 그 영향은 심리와 선적 결정에서 먼저 나타나고, 그 다음 가격에 나타날 것입니다.

segments.src: Higher tariffs usually raise costs for importers, who may absorb them, pass them to consumers or change suppliers.
segments.tr: 더 높은 관세는 일반적으로 수입업체의 비용을 상승시키며, 수입업체는 이를 흡수하거나 소비자에게 전가하거나 공급업체를 변경할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Renewed rare-earth restrictions could affect production schedules for magnets and related components, with delays reaching manufacturers months later.
segments.tr: 새로운 희토류 제한은 자석 및 관련 부품의 생산 일정에 영향을 미칠 수 있으며, 지연은 몇 달 후 제조업체에 도달할 것입니다.

segments.src: Farmers would face renewed uncertainty about one of their largest export markets.
segments.tr: 농부들은 가장 큰 수출 시장 중 하나에 대한 새로운 불확실성에 직면하게 될 것입니다.

segments.src: ## What it means for prices and supply chains
segments.tr: ## 가격과 공급망에 미치는 의미

segments.src: - **Consumers.** Tariff costs are only one part of retail prices, and effects vary by product. Categories with high import shares from China, such as some electronics, appliances and toys, are more exposed to rate changes than others.
segments.tr: - **소비자.** 관세 비용은 소매 가격의 일부일 뿐이며, 영향은 제품마다 다릅니다. 일부 전자제품, 가전제품, 장난감과 같이 중국산 수입 비중이 높은 범주는 다른 범주보다 세율 변화에 더 많이 노출되어 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Manufacturers.** Many firms have spent the past year diversifying suppliers, building inventory buffers or shifting some assembly to other countries. These adjustments reduce but do not eliminate exposure, particularly for specialized inputs where few alternatives exist.
segments.tr: - **제조업체.** 많은 기업이 지난 1년 동안 공급업체를 다변화하고, 재고 완충 장치를 구축하거나, 일부 조립 공정을 다른 국가로 이전하는 데 시간을 보냈습니다. 이러한 조정은 노출을 줄이지만 제거하지는 못하며, 특히 대체재가 거의 없는 특수 투입재의 경우 더욱 그렇습니다.

segments.src: - **Farmers and agribusiness.** Soybean prices and export demand are sensitive to Chinese buying. Steady purchases support farm incomes, while disruptions tend to push growers toward other markets and lower-priced sales.
segments.tr: - **농부 및 농업 기업.** 대두 가격과 수출 수요는 중국의 구매에 민감합니다. 꾸준한 구매는 농가 소득을 뒷받침하지만, 중단은 생산자들이 다른 시장으로 눈을 돌리게 하고 더 낮은 가격의 판매로 이어지는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Investors and businesses.** Currency movements, shipping rates and commodity prices often react to trade headlines. Long-term planning typically depends less on any single announcement than on whether rules appear stable.
segments.tr: - **투자자 및 기업.** 환율 변동, 운송 요금, 원자재 가격은 종종 무역 헤드라인에 반응합니다. 장기 계획은 일반적으로 단일 발표보다는 규칙이 안정적으로 보이는지 여부에 더 많이 의존합니다.

segments.tr: ## 다음으로 주목할 점

segments.tr: - 백악관, 미국 무역대표부, 중국 상무부의 연장 또는 새로운 협상에 관한 공식 성명

segments.src: - Monthly customs data on soybean shipments and rare-earth magnet exports
segments.tr: - 대두 선적 및 희토류 자석 수출에 대한 월간 관세 데이터

segments.src: - Changes to chip-related export rules from either government
segments.tr: - 양국 정부의 칩 관련 수출 규정 변경 사항

segments.src: - Court decisions affecting U.S. tariff authority
segments.tr: - 미국의 관세 권한에 영향을 미치는 법원 판결

segments.src: - Company earnings commentary on costs, sourcing and lead times
segments.tr: - 비용, 소싱 및 리드 타임에 대한 기업 실적 코멘트

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: The truce bought time rather than a settlement.
segments.tr: 휴전은 합의가 아니라 시간을 벌어준 것입니다.

segments.src: Its first year showed that both governments can lower tensions when they choose to, and that the arrangement depends on follow-through that is hard to measure from outside.
segments.tr: 첫 1년은 양국 정부가 원할 때 긴장을 완화할 수 있다는 것과, 이 합의가 외부에서 측정하기 어려운 후속 조치에 달려 있다는 것을 보여주었습니다.

segments.src: Whether it is extended, rebuilt or allowed to expire, the outcome will shape costs and planning for households, farms and factories well beyond the two capitals involved.
segments.tr: 연장되든, 재구축되든, 만료되든, 그 결과는 관련된 두 수도를 넘어 가계, 농장, 공장의 비용과 계획을 형성할 것입니다.

segments.src: When President Donald Trump and President Xi Jinping met in Busan, South Korea, on October 30, 2025, the two sides agreed to a one-year pause in several of their sharpest trade measures.
segments.tr: 当唐纳德·特朗普总统与习近平主席于2025年10月30日在韩国釜山会晤时，双方同意对几项最尖锐的贸易措施实施为期一年的暂停。

segments.src: The arrangement took effect in November 2025.
segments.tr: 该安排于2025年11月生效。

segments.src: Now that the first anniversary has passed, attention has turned to a simple question: **will the pause be extended, reshaped, or allowed to lapse?**
segments.tr: 现在一周年已过，人们的注意力转向了一个简单的问题：**暂停期是会延长、重塑，还是任其失效？**

segments.src: This article summarizes what the truce covered, what each side has done under it, which issues remain open, and how different outcomes could affect prices and supply chains.
segments.tr: 本文总结了休战涵盖的内容、双方在休战期间采取的行动、哪些问题仍未解决，以及不同的结果可能如何影响价格和供应链。

segments.src: Trade policy changes quickly, so check official announcements for the latest status.
segments.tr: 贸易政策变化迅速，因此请查看官方公告以了解最新状态。

segments.src: ## Why the truce mattered
segments.tr: ## 为什么休战很重要

segments.src: Through 2025, tariffs and export restrictions between the world's two largest economies escalated in steps.
segments.tr: 在2025年全年，全球两大经济体之间的关税和出口限制措施逐步升级。

segments.src: Tariff rates on many goods climbed to levels that analysts warned could effectively halt trade in affected categories.
segments.tr: 许多商品的关税税率攀升至分析师警告可能有效阻断受影响类别贸易的水平。

segments.src: China also announced broader controls on rare-earth materials and related technologies, which are essential to magnets used in electric vehicles, wind turbines, electronics and defense equipment.
segments.tr: 中国还宣布对稀土材料及相关技术实施更广泛的管制，这些材料对于电动汽车、风力涡轮机、电子产品和国防设备中使用的磁铁至关重要。

segments.src: The Busan arrangement did not resolve the underlying disagreements.
segments.tr: 釜山安排并没有解决根本分歧。

segments.src: It lowered the temperature, giving businesses a more predictable window for planning.
segments.tr: 它降低了紧张局势，为企业提供了一个更具可预测性的规划窗口。

segments.src: That predictability is the main thing at stake now.
segments.tr: 这种可预测性是目前利害攸关的主要问题。

segments.src: ## What the truce covered
segments.tr: ## 休战涵盖的内容

segments.src: The main elements, as announced by both governments in late 2025, were:
segments.tr: 正如两国政府在2025年底所宣布的那样，主要内容包括：

segments.src: - **Tariffs.** The United States reduced the so-called fentanyl-related tariff on Chinese goods from 20% to 10% and extended a suspension of higher reciprocal tariff rates. Existing tariffs from earlier years, including Section 301 duties, largely remained in place.
segments.tr: - **关税。** 美国将所谓的针对中国商品的芬太尼相关关税从20%降至10%，并延长了对更高互惠关税税率的暂停期。早些年实施的现有关税，包括301条款关税，在很大程度上仍然有效。

segments.src: - **Rare earths.** China agreed to suspend the sweeping export-control measures it announced in October 2025 and to issue general licenses for certain materials. Earlier licensing requirements introduced in April 2025 stayed in force, so the system was eased rather than removed.
segments.tr: - **稀土。** 中国同意暂停其在2025年10月宣布的全面出口管制措施，并为某些材料发放一般许可证。2025年4月引入的早期许可要求仍然有效，因此该系统是得到了放宽而非取消。

segments.src: - **Agricultural purchases.** China committed to resume large-scale purchases of U.S. soybeans, with a stated target of about 12 million metric tons in late 2025 and 25 million metric tons annually in the following years.
segments.tr: - **农产品采购。** 中国承诺恢复大规模采购美国大豆，既定目标是2025年底约为1200万公吨，随后几年每年2500万公吨。

segments.src: - **Other pauses.** Both sides suspended some recently introduced measures, including certain port fees on ships and a U.S. rule that would have extended export restrictions to subsidiaries of listed companies.
segments.tr: - **其他暂停措施。** 双方暂停了一些近期引入的措施，包括针对船舶的某些港口费用，以及一项本会将出口限制扩大到上市公司子公司的美国规则。

segments.src: ## What each side has delivered
segments.tr: ## 各方交付了什么

segments.src: Assessing compliance is harder than it sounds, because the commitments were described in general terms and verification relies on trade data that is published with a delay.
segments.tr: 评估合规性比听起来要困难，因为承诺是以一般性条款描述的，且验证依赖于有滞后发布的贸易数据。

segments.src: **On soybeans,** the key metrics are monthly customs data and U.S.
segments.tr: **在大豆方面，** 关键指标是月度海关数据和美国

segments.src: Department of Agriculture export reports.
segments.tr: 农业部的出口报告。

segments.src: Purchases are typically made by state-linked buyers, and timing follows seasonal patterns: the U.S.
segments.tr: 采购通常由与国家相关的买家进行，时间安排遵循季节性模式：美国

segments.src: harvest and export season runs mainly from autumn through winter, while Brazil dominates Chinese imports in the first half of the year.
segments.tr: 的收获和出口季节主要从秋季持续到冬季，而巴西在一年中的上半年主导了中国的进口。

segments.src: Because of that seasonality, a full-year tally is more meaningful than any single month.
segments.tr: 由于这种季节性，全年的统计数字比任何单个月份都更有意义。

segments.src: Analysts have also noted that the 25-million-ton annual figure is below the volumes China bought from the United States in the years before the trade war, so meeting it would be a partial recovery, not a return to the old baseline.
segments.tr: 分析师还指出，2500万吨的年度数字低于贸易战前几年中国从美国购买的量，因此达到这一目标将是部分恢复，而非回到旧的基准线。

segments.src: **On rare earths,** the practical test is whether exporters can obtain licenses reliably and quickly.
segments.tr: **在稀土方面，** 实际的考验是出口商能否可靠且快速地获得许可证。

segments.src: Companies in automotive and electronics supply chains have reported that approvals and delivery times matter as much as the formal rules.
segments.tr: 汽车和电子供应链中的企业报告称，审批和交付时间与正式规则同样重要。

segments.src: Even with general licenses, China retains the ability to slow or tighten approvals, which is why many manufacturers continue to look for alternative sources.
segments.tr: 即使有一般许可证，中国仍保留减缓或收紧审批的能力，这就是为什么许多制造商继续寻找替代来源的原因。

segments.src: **On tariffs,** the United States has kept the reduced rates in place during the truce period, though other tariff actions, including sector-specific measures and legal challenges to the use of emergency powers for tariffs, have continued to shape the broader picture.
segments.tr: **在关税方面，** 美国在休战期间保持了降低后的税率，尽管其他关税行动，包括特定行业的措施以及对利用紧急权力征收关税的法律挑战，继续塑造着更广泛的局面。

segments.src: ## What remains unresolved
segments.tr: ## 哪些问题仍未解决

segments.src: Several issues were deliberately left for later:
segments.tr: 有几个问题被刻意留待以后解决：

segments.src: 1. **Technology controls.** Restrictions on advanced semiconductors and chipmaking equipment remain a central point of friction. Each side's decisions in this area can trigger responses elsewhere.
segments.tr: 1. **技术管制。** 对先进半导体和芯片制造设备的限制仍然是摩擦的核心点。双方在这一领域的决定可能会引发其他地方的反应。

segments.src: 2. **Structural concerns.** U.S. officials continue to raise questions about industrial subsidies, overcapacity and market access. Chinese officials point to U.S. tariffs and export restrictions as barriers to normal trade.
segments.tr: 2. **结构性担忧。** 美国官员继续提出关于产业补贴、产能过剩和市场准入的问题。中国官员则指出美国的关税和出口限制是正常贸易的障碍。

segments.src: 3. **Legal uncertainty.** Court rulings on the authority behind some U.S. tariffs could change the tools available to the administration, even if the political deal holds.
segments.tr: 3. **法律不确定性。** 法院对美国部分关税背后权力的裁决可能会改变政府可用的工具，即使政治协议仍然有效。

segments.src: 4. **Durability.** A one-year arrangement invites a recurring cliff. Companies must decide whether to treat the current rates as a stable base or as a temporary window.
segments.tr: 4. **持久性。** 为期一年的安排导致了反复出现的悬崖。企业必须决定是将当前税率视为稳定的基础，还是视为一个临时窗口。

segments.src: ## Scenarios: extension, breakdown or something in between
segments.tr: ## 情景：延长、破裂或介于两者之间

segments.src: **Extension or a broader follow-up deal.** If both governments prolong the pause, the most likely effect is continuity: current tariff levels stay roughly in place, rare-earth licensing continues, and importers keep planning around today's costs.
segments.tr: **延长或达成更广泛的后续协议。** 如果两国政府延长暂停期，最可能的影响是连续性：当前的关税水平大致保持不变，稀土许可继续进行，进口商继续围绕今天的成本进行规划。

segments.src: A longer horizon would make it easier for businesses to commit to inventory and sourcing decisions, though it would not erase the tariffs that already exist.
segments.tr: 更长的时间跨度将使企业更容易做出库存和采购决策，尽管这不会消除已经存在的关税。

segments.src: **Partial lapse or selective tightening.** A middle path could involve some measures returning while others are kept in place.
segments.tr: **部分失效或选择性收紧。** 中间道路可能涉及某些措施恢复，而其他措施保持不变。

segments.src: This would likely produce uneven effects across industries.
segments.tr: 这可能会在不同行业产生不均衡的影响。

segments.src: Sectors reliant on rare-earth inputs or on specific agricultural exports would be especially sensitive.
segments.tr: 依赖稀土投入或特定农产品出口的行业将特别敏感。

segments.src: **Breakdown.** If suspended measures snapped back, the effects would likely appear first in sentiment and shipping decisions, then in prices.
segments.tr: **破裂。** 如果暂停的措施突然恢复，影响可能会首先出现在情绪和航运决策中，然后是价格上。

segments.src: Higher tariffs usually raise costs for importers, who may absorb them, pass them to consumers or change suppliers.
segments.tr: 更高的关税通常会增加进口商的成本，他们可能会吸收这些成本，将其转嫁给消费者，或更换供应商。

segments.src: Renewed rare-earth restrictions could affect production schedules for magnets and related components, with delays reaching manufacturers months later.
segments.tr: 重新实施的稀土限制可能会影响磁铁及相关组件的生产计划，延迟会在几个月后波及制造商。

segments.src: Farmers would face renewed uncertainty about one of their largest export markets.
segments.tr: 农民将面临其最大的出口市场之一带来的重新出现的不确定性。

segments.src: ## What it means for prices and supply chains
segments.tr: ## 这对价格和供应链意味着什么

segments.src: - **Consumers.** Tariff costs are only one part of retail prices, and effects vary by product. Categories with high import shares from China, such as some electronics, appliances and toys, are more exposed to rate changes than others.
segments.tr: - **消费者。** 关税成本只是零售价格的一部分，影响因产品而异。从中国进口份额较高的类别，如某些电子产品、电器和玩具，比其他类别更容易受到税率变化的影响。

segments.src: - **Manufacturers.** Many firms have spent the past year diversifying suppliers, building inventory buffers or shifting some assembly to other countries. These adjustments reduce but do not eliminate exposure, particularly for specialized inputs where few alternatives exist.
segments.tr: - **制造商。** 许多公司在过去一年中花费精力实现供应商多元化、建立库存缓冲或将部分组装转移到其他国家。这些调整减少但并未消除风险，特别是对于几乎没有替代品的专业投入品而言。

segments.src: - **Farmers and agribusiness.** Soybean prices and export demand are sensitive to Chinese buying. Steady purchases support farm incomes, while disruptions tend to push growers toward other markets and lower-priced sales.
segments.tr: - **农民和农业综合企业。** 大豆价格和出口需求对中国的购买行为很敏感。稳定的采购支持农场收入，而中断往往会促使种植者转向其他市场和低价销售。

segments.src: - **Investors and businesses.** Currency movements, shipping rates and commodity prices often react to trade headlines. Long-term planning typically depends less on any single announcement than on whether rules appear stable.
segments.tr: - **投资者和企业。** 货币走势、运费和大宗商品价格往往会对贸易头条新闻做出反应。长期规划通常较少依赖于任何单一公告，而更多取决于规则是否看起来稳定。

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## 下一步关注什么

segments.src: - Official statements from the White House, the U.S. Trade Representative and China's Ministry of Commerce on any extension or new talks
segments.tr: - 白宫、美国贸易代表办公室和中国商务部关于任何延长或新谈判的官方声明

segments.src: - Monthly customs data on soybean shipments and rare-earth magnet exports
segments.tr: - 关于大豆运输和稀土磁铁出口的月度海关数据

segments.src: - Changes to chip-related export rules from either government
segments.tr: - 任何一方政府对芯片相关出口规则的变更

segments.src: - Court decisions affecting U.S. tariff authority
segments.tr: - 影响美国关税权力的法院裁决

segments.src: - Company earnings commentary on costs, sourcing and lead times
segments.tr: - 公司财报中关于成本、采购和交货时间的评论

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 底线

segments.src: The truce bought time rather than a settlement.
segments.tr: 休战换来的是时间，而非解决方案。

segments.src: Its first year showed that both governments can lower tensions when they choose to, and that the arrangement depends on follow-through that is hard to measure from outside.
segments.tr: 其第一年表明，两国政府在选择时能够降低紧张局势，且该安排依赖于从外部难以衡量的后续执行情况。

segments.src: Whether it is extended, rebuilt or allowed to expire, the outcome will shape costs and planning for households, farms and factories well beyond the two capitals involved.
segments.tr: 无论它是被延长、重建还是任其到期，结果都将影响到相关两个首都之外的家庭、农场和工厂的成本和规划。

segments.src: Analysts have also noted that the 25-million-ton annual figure is below the volumes China bought from the United States in the years before the trade war, so meeting it would be a partial recovery, not a return to the old baseline.
segments.tr: Los analistas también han señalado que la cifra anual de 25 millones de toneladas está por debajo de los volúmenes que China compró a Estados Unidos en los años anteriores a la guerra comercial, por lo que alcanzarla supondría una recuperación parcial, no una vuelta a la situación de partida anterior.

segments.src: **On rare earths,** the practical test is whether exporters can obtain licenses reliably and quickly.
segments.tr: **On rare earths,** la prueba práctica es si los exportadores pueden obtener licencias de forma fiable y rápida.

segments.src: Companies in automotive and electronics supply chains have reported that approvals and delivery times matter as much as the formal rules.
segments.tr: Las empresas de las cadenas de suministro de automoción y electrónica han informado de que las aprobaciones y los plazos de entrega importan tanto como las normas formales.

segments.src: Even with general licenses, China retains the ability to slow or tighten approvals, which is why many manufacturers continue to look for alternative sources.
segments.tr: Incluso con licencias generales, China conserva la capacidad de ralentizar o endurecer las aprobaciones, razón por la cual muchos fabricantes siguen buscando fuentes alternativas.

segments.src: **On tariffs,** the United States has kept the reduced rates in place during the truce period, though other tariff actions, including sector-specific measures and legal challenges to the use of emergency powers for tariffs, have continued to shape the broader picture.
segments.tr: **On tariffs,** Estados Unidos ha mantenido los tipos reducidos durante el periodo de tregua, aunque otras acciones arancelarias, incluidas medidas específicas por sectores y recursos legales contra el uso de poderes de emergencia para los aranceles, han seguido configurando el panorama general.

segments.src: ## What remains unresolved
segments.tr: ## Qué sigue sin resolverse

segments.src: Several issues were deliberately left for later:
segments.tr: Varios asuntos se dejaron deliberadamente para más adelante:

segments.src: 1. **Technology controls.** Restrictions on advanced semiconductors and chipmaking equipment remain a central point of friction. Each side's decisions in this area can trigger responses elsewhere.
segments.tr: 1. **Technology controls.** Las restricciones a los semiconductores avanzados y a los equipos de fabricación de chips siguen siendo un punto central de fricción. Las decisiones de cada parte en este ámbito pueden desencadenar respuestas en otros lugares.

segments.src: 2. **Structural concerns.** U.S. officials continue to raise questions about industrial subsidies, overcapacity and market access. Chinese officials point to U.S. tariffs and export restrictions as barriers to normal trade.
segments.tr: 2. **Structural concerns.** Los funcionarios estadounidenses siguen planteando dudas sobre los subvenciones industriales, el exceso de capacidad y el acceso a los mercados. Los funcionarios chinos señalan los aranceles y las restricciones a la exportación de EE. UU. como barreras para el comercio normal.

segments.src: 3. **Legal uncertainty.** Court rulings on the authority behind some U.S. tariffs could change the tools available to the administration, even if the political deal holds.
segments.tr: 3. **Legal uncertainty.** Las sentencias judiciales sobre la autoridad en la que se basan algunos aranceles estadounidenses podrían cambiar las herramientas disponibles para la administración, incluso si el acuerdo político se mantiene.

segments.src: 4. **Durability.** A one-year arrangement invites a recurring cliff. Companies must decide whether to treat the current rates as a stable base or as a temporary window.
segments.tr: 4. **Durability.** Un acuerdo de un año invita a un abismo recurrente. Las empresas deben decidir si tratan los tipos actuales como una base estable o como una ventana temporal.

segments.src: ## Scenarios: extension, breakdown or something in between
segments.tr: ## Escenarios: prórroga, ruptura o algo intermedio

segments.src: **Extension or a broader follow-up deal.** If both governments prolong the pause, the most likely effect is continuity: current tariff levels stay roughly in place, rare-earth licensing continues, and importers keep planning around today's costs.
segments.tr: **Extension or a broader follow-up deal.** Si ambos gobiernos prolongan la pausa, el efecto más probable es la continuidad: los niveles arancelarios actuales se mantienen más o menos igual, la concesión de licencias de tierras raras continúa y los importadores siguen planificando en función de los costes actuales.

segments.src: A longer horizon would make it easier for businesses to commit to inventory and sourcing decisions, though it would not erase the tariffs that already exist.
segments.tr: Un horizonte más amplio facilitaría que las empresas se comprometan con las decisiones de inventario y aprovisionamiento, aunque no borraría los aranceles ya existentes.

segments.src: **Partial lapse or selective tightening.** A middle path could involve some measures returning while others are kept in place.
segments.tr: **Partial lapse or selective tightening.** Una vía intermedia podría implicar el retorno de algunas medidas mientras otras se mantienen.

segments.src: This would likely produce uneven effects across industries.
segments.tr: Esto probablemente produciría efectos desiguales en todas las industrias.

segments.src: Sectors reliant on rare-earth inputs or on specific agricultural exports would be especially sensitive.
segments.tr: Los sectores dependientes de insumos de tierras raras o de exportaciones agrícolas específicas serían especialmente sensibles.

segments.src: **Breakdown.** If suspended measures snapped back, the effects would likely appear first in sentiment and shipping decisions, then in prices.
segments.tr: **Breakdown.** Si las medidas suspendidas volvieran a aplicarse, los efectos probablemente aparecerían primero en el sentimiento y las decisiones de envío, y después en los precios.

segments.src: Higher tariffs usually raise costs for importers, who may absorb them, pass them to consumers or change suppliers.
segments.tr: Los aranceles más altos suelen elevar los costes para los importadores, que pueden asumirlos, trasladarlos a los consumidores o cambiar de proveedor.

segments.src: Renewed rare-earth restrictions could affect production schedules for magnets and related components, with delays reaching manufacturers months later.
segments.tr: La renovación de las restricciones sobre las tierras raras podría afectar a los calendarios de producción de imanes y componentes relacionados, y los retrasos llegarían a los fabricantes meses después.

segments.src: Farmers would face renewed uncertainty about one of their largest export markets.
segments.tr: Los agricultores se enfrentarían a una nueva incertidumbre sobre uno de sus mayores mercados de exportación.

segments.src: ## What it means for prices and supply chains
segments.tr: ## Qué significa para los precios y las cadenas de suministro

segments.src: - **Consumers.** Tariff costs are only one part of retail prices, and effects vary by product. Categories with high import shares from China, such as some electronics, appliances and toys, are more exposed to rate changes than others.
segments.tr: - **Consumers.** Los costes de los aranceles son solo una parte de los precios al por menor, y los efectos varían según el producto. Las categorías con una alta cuota de importación de China, como algunos productos electrónicos, electrodomésticos y juguetes, están más expuestas a los cambios de tipos que otras.

segments.src: - **Manufacturers.** Many firms have spent the past year diversifying suppliers, building inventory buffers or shifting some assembly to other countries. These adjustments reduce but do not eliminate exposure, particularly for specialized inputs where few alternatives exist.
segments.tr: - **Manufacturers.** Muchas empresas han pasado el último año diversificando proveedores, creando reservas de inventario o trasladando parte del montaje a otros países. Estos ajustes reducen pero no eliminan la exposición, en particular para los insumos especializados en los que existen pocas alternativas.

segments.src: - **Farmers and agribusiness.** Soybean prices and export demand are sensitive to Chinese buying. Steady purchases support farm incomes, while disruptions tend to push growers toward other markets and lower-priced sales.
segments.tr: - **Farmers and agribusiness.** Los precios de la soja y la demanda de exportación son sensibles a las compras chinas. Unas compras constantes apoyan los ingresos agrícolas, mientras que las perturbaciones tienden a empujar a los productores hacia otros mercados y ventas a precios más bajos.

segments.src: - **Investors and businesses.** Currency movements, shipping rates and commodity prices often react to trade headlines. Long-term planning typically depends less on any single announcement than on whether rules appear stable.
segments.tr: - **Investors and businesses.** Los movimientos de las divisa, las tarifas de transporte y los precios de las materias primas suelen reaccionar a los titulares comerciales. La planificación a largo plazo suele depender menos de un único anuncio que de si las normas parecen estables.

segments.tr: ## Qué vigilar a continuación

segments.tr: - Declaraciones oficiales de la Casa Blanca, el Representante de Comercio de EE. UU. y el Ministerio de Comercio de China sobre cualquier prórroga o nuevas conversaciones

segments.tr: - Datos mensuales de aduanas sobre los envíos de soja y las exportaciones de imanes de tierras raras

segments.tr: - Cambios en las normas de exportación relacionadas con los chips por parte de cualquiera de los dos gobiernos

segments.tr: - Decisiones judiciales que afecten a la autoridad arancelaria de EE. UU.

segments.tr: - Comentarios de los resultados de las empresas sobre costes, abastecimiento y plazos de entrega

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Conclusión

segments.src: The truce bought time rather than a settlement.
segments.tr: La tregua compró tiempo en lugar de un acuerdo definitivo.

segments.src: Its first year showed that both governments can lower tensions when they choose to, and that the arrangement depends on follow-through that is hard to measure from outside.
segments.tr: Su primer año demostró que ambos gobiernos pueden reducir las tensiones cuando así lo deciden, y que el acuerdo depende de un seguimiento difícil de medir desde el exterior.

segments.src: Whether it is extended, rebuilt or allowed to expire, the outcome will shape costs and planning for households, farms and factories well beyond the two capitals involved.
segments.tr: Ya sea que se prorrogue, se reestructure o se deje expirar, el resultado moldeará los costes y la planificación de los hogares, las granjas y las fábricas mucho más allá de las dos capitales implicadas.

segments.src: The main elements, as announced by both governments in late 2025, were:

segments.src: - **Tariffs.** The United States reduced the so-called fentanyl-related tariff on Chinese goods from 20% to 10% and extended a suspension of higher reciprocal tariff rates. Existing tariffs from earlier years, including Section 301 duties, largely remained in place.
segments.tr: - **الرسوم الجمركية.** خفضت الولايات المتحدة ما يسمى بالرسوم الجمركية المتعلقة بالفنتانيل على السلع الصينية من 20% إلى 10% ومددت تعليق معدلات الرسوم الجمركية المتبادلة الأعلى. ظلت الرسوم الجمركية الحالية من السنوات السابقة، بما في ذلك رسوم القسم 301، سارية إلى حد كبير.

segments.src: - **Rare earths.** China agreed to suspend the sweeping export-control measures it announced in October 2025 and to issue general licenses for certain materials. Earlier licensing requirements introduced in April 2025 stayed in force, so the system was eased rather than removed.
segments.tr: - **الأراضي النادرة.** وافقت الصين على تعليق تدابير مراقبة الصادرات الشاملة التي أعلنت عنها في أكتوبر 2025 وإصدار تراخيص عامة لمواد معينة. ظلت متطلبات الترخيص السابقة التي تم إدخالها في أبريل 2025 سارية، لذلك تم تخفيف النظام بدلاً من إزالته.

segments.src: - **Agricultural purchases.** China committed to resume large-scale purchases of U.S. soybeans, with a stated target of about 12 million metric tons in late 2025 and 25 million metric tons annually in the following years.
segments.tr: - **المشتريات الزراعية.** التزمت الصين باستئناف مشتريات واسعة النطاق من فول الصويا الأمريكي، مع هدف معلن يبلغ حوالي 12 مليون طن متري في أواخر 2025 و25 مليون طن متري سنوياً في السنوات التالية.

segments.src: - **Other pauses.** Both sides suspended some recently introduced measures, including certain port fees on ships and a U.S. rule that would have extended export restrictions to subsidiaries of listed companies.
segments.tr: - **وقفات أخرى.** علق الجانبان بعض التدابير التي تم إدخالها مؤخراً، بما في ذلك بعض رسوم الموانئ على السفن والقاعدة الأمريكية التي كان من شأنها تمديد القيود المفروضة على الصادرات لتشمل الشركات التابعة للشركات المدرجة.

segments.src: ## What it means for prices and supply chains
segments.tr: ## ما يعنيه ذلك للأسعار وسلاسل الإمداد

segments.src: - **Consumers.** Tariff costs are only one part of retail prices, and effects vary by product. Categories with high import shares from China, such as some electronics, appliances and toys, are more exposed to rate changes than others.
segments.tr: - **المستهلكون.** تكاليف الرسوم الجمركية هي جزء واحد فقط من أسعار التجزئة، وتختلف التأثيرات حسب المنتج. الفئات ذات حصص الاستيراد العالية من الصين، مثل بعض الإلكترونيات، الأجهزة والألعاب، أكثر عرضة لتغيرات الأسعار من غيرها.

segments.src: - **Manufacturers.** Many firms have spent the past year diversifying suppliers, building inventory buffers or shifting some assembly to other countries. These adjustments reduce but do not eliminate exposure, particularly for specialized inputs where few alternatives exist.
segments.tr: - **المصنعون.** أمضى العديد من الشركات العام الماضي في تنويع الموردين، بناء مخازن المخزون أو تحويل بعض التجميع إلى بلدان أخرى. تقلل هذه التعديلات ولكنها لا تلغي التعرض، لا سيما بالنسبة للمدخلات المتخصصة حيث توجد بدائل قليلة.

segments.src: - **Farmers and agribusiness.** Soybean prices and export demand are sensitive to Chinese buying. Steady purchases support farm incomes, while disruptions tend to push growers toward other markets and lower-priced sales.
segments.tr: - **المزارعون والأعمال الزراعية.** أسعار فول الصويا وطلب التصدير حساسة لعمليات الشراء الصينية. تدعم المشتريات المستقرة دخول المزارع، بينما تميل الاضطرابات إلى دفع المزارعين نحو أسواق أخرى ومبيعات أقل سعراً.

segments.src: - **Investors and businesses.** Currency movements, shipping rates and commodity prices often react to trade headlines. Long-term planning typically depends less on any single announcement than on whether rules appear stable.

fr.title: Un an après la trêve : quels sont les enjeux de la détente commerciale entre les États-Unis et la Chine

segments.src: When President Donald Trump and President Xi Jinping met in Busan, South Korea, on October 30, 2025, the two sides agreed to a one-year pause in several of their sharpest trade measures.
segments.tr: Lorsque le président Donald Trump et le président Xi Jinping se sont rencontrés à Busan, en Corée du Sud, le 30 octobre 2025, les deux parties ont convenu d'une pause d'un an dans plusieurs de leurs mesures commerciales les plus strictes.

segments.src: The arrangement took effect in November 2025.
segments.tr: L'accord est entré en vigueur en novembre 2025.

segments.src: Now that the first anniversary has passed, attention has turned to a simple question: **will the pause be extended, reshaped, or allowed to lapse?**
segments.tr: Maintenant que le premier anniversaire est passé, l'attention s'est tournée vers une question simple : **la pause sera-t-elle prolongée, modifiée ou laissée à l'abandon ?**

segments.src: This article summarizes what the truce covered, what each side has done under it, which issues remain open, and how different outcomes could affect prices and supply chains.
segments.tr: Cet article résume ce que la trêve a couvert, ce que chaque partie a fait dans ce cadre, quelles questions restent ouvertes et comment différents résultats pourraient affecter les prix et les chaînes d'approvisionnement.

segments.src: Trade policy changes quickly, so check official announcements for the latest status.
segments.tr: La politique commerciale évoluant rapidement, consultez les annonces officielles pour connaître le dernier état.

segments.src: ## Why the truce mattered
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi la trêve a compté

segments.src: Through 2025, tariffs and export restrictions between the world's two largest economies escalated in steps.
segments.tr: Tout au long de 2025, les tarifs douaniers et les restrictions à l'exportation entre les deux plus grandes économies du monde ont augmenté par étapes.

segments.src: Tariff rates on many goods climbed to levels that analysts warned could effectively halt trade in affected categories.
segments.tr: Les taux de droits de douane sur de nombreux biens ont atteint des niveaux que les analystes ont avertis pourraient effectivement stopper le commerce dans les catégories touchées.

segments.src: China also announced broader controls on rare-earth materials and related technologies, which are essential to magnets used in electric vehicles, wind turbines, electronics and defense equipment.
segments.tr: La Chine a également annoncé des contrôles plus larges sur les matériaux de terres rares et les technologies associées, qui sont essentiels pour les aimants utilisés dans les véhicules électriques, les éoliennes, l'électronique et les équipements de défense.

segments.src: The Busan arrangement did not resolve the underlying disagreements.
segments.tr: L'accord de Busan n'a pas résolu les désaccords sous-jacents.

segments.src: It lowered the temperature, giving businesses a more predictable window for planning.
segments.tr: Il a baissé la température, offrant aux entreprises une fenêtre plus prévisible pour la planification.

segments.src: That predictability is the main thing at stake now.
segments.tr: Cette prévisibilité est l'élément principal en jeu maintenant.

segments.src: ## What the truce covered
segments.tr: ## Ce que la trêve a couvert

segments.src: The main elements, as announced by both governments in late 2025, were:
segments.tr: Les principaux éléments, tels qu'annoncés par les deux gouvernements fin 2025, étaient :

segments.src: - **Tariffs.** The United States reduced the so-called fentanyl-related tariff on Chinese goods from 20% to 10% and extended a suspension of higher reciprocal tariff rates. Existing tariffs from earlier years, including Section 301 duties, largely remained in place.
segments.tr: - **Tarifs.** Les États-Unis ont réduit le tarif dit lié au fentanyle sur les produits chinois de 20% à 10% et ont prolongé la suspension des taux de droits de douane réciproques plus élevés. Les tarifs existants des années précédentes, y compris les droits de la section 301, sont restés en grande partie en place.

segments.src: - **Rare earths.** China agreed to suspend the sweeping export-control measures it announced in October 2025 and to issue general licenses for certain materials. Earlier licensing requirements introduced in April 2025 stayed in force, so the system was eased rather than removed.
segments.tr: - **Terres rares.** La Chine a accepté de suspendre les mesures globales de contrôle des exportations qu'elle avait annoncées en octobre 2025 et de délivrer des licences générales pour certains matériaux. Les exigences de licence antérieures introduites en avril 2025 sont restées en vigueur, de sorte que le système a été assoupli plutôt que supprimé.

segments.src: - **Agricultural purchases.** China committed to resume large-scale purchases of U.S. soybeans, with a stated target of about 12 million metric tons in late 2025 and 25 million metric tons annually in the following years.
segments.tr: - **Achats agricoles.** La Chine s'est engagée à reprendre les achats à grande échelle de soja américain, avec un objectif déclaré d'environ 12 millions de tonnes métriques fin 2025 et de 25 millions de tonnes métriques par an les années suivantes.

segments.src: - **Other pauses.** Both sides suspended some recently introduced measures, including certain port fees on ships and a U.S. rule that would have extended export restrictions to subsidiaries of listed companies.
segments.tr: - **Autres pauses.** Les deux parties ont suspendu certaines mesures récemment introduites, y compris certains frais de port sur les navires et une règle américaine qui aurait étendu les restrictions à l'exportation aux filiales d'entreprises cotées.

segments.src: ## What each side has delivered
segments.tr: ## Ce que chaque partie a livré

segments.src: Assessing compliance is harder than it sounds, because the commitments were described in general terms and verification relies on trade data that is published with a delay.
segments.tr: L'évaluation de la conformité est plus difficile qu'il n'y paraît, car les engagements ont été décrits en termes généraux et la vérification repose sur des données commerciales publiées avec un retard.

segments.src: **On soybeans,** the key metrics are monthly customs data and U.S.
segments.tr: **Sur le soja,** les mesures clés sont les données douanières mensuelles et les rapports d'exportation du

segments.src: Department of Agriculture export reports.
segments.tr: Département de l'Agriculture des États-Unis.

segments.src: Purchases are typically made by state-linked buyers, and timing follows seasonal patterns: the U.S.
segments.tr: Les achats sont généralement effectués par des acheteurs liés à l'État, et le calendrier suit des schémas saisonniers : la saison des récoltes et des exportations des

segments.src: harvest and export season runs mainly from autumn through winter, while Brazil dominates Chinese imports in the first half of the year.
segments.tr: États-Unis s'étend principalement de l'automne à l'hiver, tandis que le Brésil domine les importations chinoises au cours du premier semestre de l'année.

segments.src: Because of that seasonality, a full-year tally is more meaningful than any single month.
segments.tr: En raison de cette saisonnalité, un décompte sur toute l'année est plus significatif que n'importe quel mois unique.

segments.src: Analysts have also noted that the 25-million-ton annual figure is below the volumes China bought from the United States in the years before the trade war, so meeting it would be a partial recovery, not a return to the old baseline.
segments.tr: Les analystes ont également noté que le chiffre annuel de 25 millions de tonnes est inférieur aux volumes que la Chine a achetés aux États-Unis dans les années précédant la guerre commerciale, de sorte que l'atteindre serait une reprise partielle, et non un retour à l'ancienne référence.

segments.src: **On rare earths,** the practical test is whether exporters can obtain licenses reliably and quickly.
segments.tr: **Sur les terres rares,** le test pratique est de savoir si les exportateurs peuvent obtenir des licences de manière fiable et rapide.

segments.src: Companies in automotive and electronics supply chains have reported that approvals and delivery times matter as much as the formal rules.
segments.tr: Les entreprises des chaînes d'approvisionnement de l'automobile et de l'électronique ont signalé que les approbations et les délais de livraison comptent autant que les règles formelles.

segments.src: Even with general licenses, China retains the ability to slow or tighten approvals, which is why many manufacturers continue to look for alternative sources.
segments.tr: Même avec des licences générales, la Chine conserve la capacité de ralentir ou de resserrer les approbations, c'est pourquoi de nombreux fabricants continuent de chercher des sources alternatives.

segments.src: **On tariffs,** the United States has kept the reduced rates in place during the truce period, though other tariff actions, including sector-specific measures and legal challenges to the use of emergency powers for tariffs, have continued to shape the broader picture.
segments.tr: **Sur les tarifs,** les États-Unis ont maintenu les taux réduits en place pendant la période de trêve, bien que d'autres actions tarifaires, y compris des mesures spécifiques au secteur et des contestations juridiques de l'utilisation des pouvoirs d'urgence pour les tarifs, aient continué à façonner le tableau d'ensemble.

segments.src: ## What remains unresolved
segments.tr: ## Ce qui reste non résolu

segments.src: Several issues were deliberately left for later:
segments.tr: Plusieurs questions ont été délibérément laissées pour plus tard :

segments.src: 1. **Technology controls.** Restrictions on advanced semiconductors and chipmaking equipment remain a central point of friction. Each side's decisions in this area can trigger responses elsewhere.
segments.tr: 1. **Contrôles technologiques.** Les restrictions sur les semi-conducteurs avancés et les équipements de fabrication de puces restent un point central de friction. Les décisions de chaque partie dans ce domaine peuvent déclencher des réponses ailleurs.

segments.src: 2. **Structural concerns.** U.S. officials continue to raise questions about industrial subsidies, overcapacity and market access. Chinese officials point to U.S. tariffs and export restrictions as barriers to normal trade.
segments.tr: 2. **Préoccupations structurelles.** Les responsables américains continuent de soulever des questions sur les subventions industrielles, la surcapacité et l'accès au marché. Les responsables chinois soulignent les tarifs douaniers et les restrictions à l'exportation des États-Unis comme des obstacles au commerce normal.

segments.src: 3. **Legal uncertainty.** Court rulings on the authority behind some U.S. tariffs could change the tools available to the administration, even if the political deal holds.
segments.tr: 3. **Incertitude juridique.** Les décisions de justice sur l'autorité derrière certains tarifs américains pourraient changer les outils disponibles pour l'administration, même si l'accord politique tient.

segments.src: 4. **Durability.** A one-year arrangement invites a recurring cliff. Companies must decide whether to treat the current rates as a stable base or as a temporary window.
segments.tr: 4. **Durabilité.** Un accord d'un an invite à une falaise récurrente. Les entreprises doivent décider si elles doivent traiter les taux actuels comme une base stable ou comme une fenêtre temporaire.

segments.src: ## Scenarios: extension, breakdown or something in between
segments.tr: ## Scénarios : prolongation, rupture ou quelque chose entre les deux

segments.src: **Extension or a broader follow-up deal.** If both governments prolong the pause, the most likely effect is continuity: current tariff levels stay roughly in place, rare-earth licensing continues, and importers keep planning around today's costs.
segments.tr: **Prolongation ou accord de suivi plus large.** Si les deux gouvernements prolongent la pause, l'effet le plus probable est la continuité : les niveaux tarifaires actuels restent à peu près en place, l'octroi de licences de terres rares se poursuit et les importateurs continuent de planifier autour des coûts d'aujourd'hui.

segments.src: A longer horizon would make it easier for businesses to commit to inventory and sourcing decisions, though it would not erase the tariffs that already exist.
segments.tr: Un horizon plus long faciliterait l'engagement des entreprises dans les décisions d'inventaire et d'approvisionnement, bien qu'il n'effacerait pas les tarifs qui existent déjà.

segments.src: **Partial lapse or selective tightening.** A middle path could involve some measures returning while others are kept in place.
segments.tr: **Échec partiel ou resserrement sélectif.** Une voie médiane pourrait impliquer le retour de certaines mesures tandis que d'autres sont maintenues en place.

segments.src: This would likely produce uneven effects across industries.
segments.tr: Cela produirait probablement des effets inégaux selon les secteurs.

segments.src: Sectors reliant on rare-earth inputs or on specific agricultural exports would be especially sensitive.
segments.tr: Les secteurs dépendants des intrants de terres rares ou d'exportations agricoles spécifiques seraient particulièrement sensibles.

segments.src: **Breakdown.** If suspended measures snapped back, the effects would likely appear first in sentiment and shipping decisions, then in prices.
segments.tr: **Rupture.** Si les mesures suspendues revenaient, les effets apparaîtraient probablement d'abord dans le sentiment et les décisions d'expédition, puis dans les prix.

segments.src: Higher tariffs usually raise costs for importers, who may absorb them, pass them to consumers or change suppliers.
segments.tr: Des tarifs plus élevés augmentent généralement les coûts pour les importateurs, qui peuvent les absorber, les répercuter sur les consommateurs ou changer de fournisseurs.

segments.src: Renewed rare-earth restrictions could affect production schedules for magnets and related components, with delays reaching manufacturers months later.
segments.tr: Le renouvellement des restrictions sur les terres rares pourrait affecter les calendriers de production des aimants et des composants connexes, les retards atteignant les fabricants des mois plus tard.

segments.src: Farmers would face renewed uncertainty about one of their largest export markets.
segments.tr: Les agriculteurs feraient face à une incertitude renouvelée concernant l'un de leurs plus grands marchés d'exportation.

segments.src: ## What it means for prices and supply chains
segments.tr: ## Ce que cela signifie pour les prix et les chaînes d'approvisionnement

segments.src: - **Consumers.** Tariff costs are only one part of retail prices, and effects vary by product. Categories with high import shares from China, such as some electronics, appliances and toys, are more exposed to rate changes than others.
segments.tr: - **Consommateurs.** Les coûts tarifaires ne sont qu'une partie des prix de détail, et les effets varient selon le produit. Les catégories ayant de fortes parts d'importation en provenance de Chine, telles que certains appareils électroniques, appareils électroménagers et jouets, sont plus exposées aux changements de taux que d'autres.

segments.src: - **Manufacturers.** Many firms have spent the past year diversifying suppliers, building inventory buffers or shifting some assembly to other countries. These adjustments reduce but do not eliminate exposure, particularly for specialized inputs where few alternatives exist.
segments.tr: - **Fabricants.** De nombreuses entreprises ont passé l'année dernière à diversifier leurs fournisseurs, à constituer des tampons de stocks ou à transférer une partie de l'assemblage vers d'autres pays. Ces ajustements réduisent mais n'éliminent pas l'exposition, en particulier pour les intrants spécialisés où peu d'alternatives existent.

segments.src: - **Farmers and agribusiness.** Soybean prices and export demand are sensitive to Chinese buying. Steady purchases support farm incomes, while disruptions tend to push growers toward other markets and lower-priced sales.
segments.tr: - **Agriculteurs et agro-industrie.** Les prix du soja et la demande d'exportation sont sensibles aux achats chinois. Des achats réguliers soutiennent les revenus des exploitations agricoles, tandis que les perturbations ont tendance à pousser les producteurs vers d'autres marchés et des ventes à prix inférieurs.

segments.src: - **Investors and businesses.** Currency movements, shipping rates and commodity prices often react to trade headlines. Long-term planning typically depends less on any single announcement than on whether rules appear stable.
segments.tr: - **Investisseurs et entreprises.** Les mouvements de devises, les taux de fret et les prix des matières premières réagissent souvent aux gros titres du commerce. La planification à long terme dépend généralement moins d'une seule annonce que de la stabilité apparente des règles.

segments.src: ## Why the truce mattered
segments.tr: ## Por que a tregua importava

segments.src: Through 2025, tariffs and export restrictions between the world's two largest economies escalated in steps.
segments.tr: Ao longo de 2025, tarifas e restrições de exportação entre as duas maiores economias do mundo escalaram em etapas.

segments.src: Tariff rates on many goods climbed to levels that analysts warned could effectively halt trade in affected categories.
segments.tr: As taxas tarifárias sobre muitos produtos subiram a níveis que analistas alertaram poderem paralisar efetivamente o comércio nas categorias afetadas.

segments.src: China also announced broader controls on rare-earth materials and related technologies, which are essential to magnets used in electric vehicles, wind turbines, electronics and defense equipment.
segments.tr: A China também anunciou controles mais amplos sobre materiais de terras raras e tecnologias relacionadas, que são essenciais para ímãs usados em veículos elétricos, turbinas eólicas, eletrônicos e equipamentos de defesa.

segments.src: The Busan arrangement did not resolve the underlying disagreements.
segments.tr: O acordo de Busan não resolveu os desacordos subjacentes.

segments.src: It lowered the temperature, giving businesses a more predictable window for planning.
segments.tr: Ele baixou a temperatura, dando às empresas uma janela mais previsível para planejamento.

segments.src: That predictability is the main thing at stake now.
segments.tr: Essa previsibilidade é a principal coisa em jogo agora.

segments.src: ## What the truce covered
segments.tr: ## O que a tregua abrangeu

segments.src: The main elements, as announced by both governments in late 2025, were:
segments.tr: Os principais elementos, conforme anunciados por ambos os governos no final de 2025, foram:

segments.src: - **Tariffs.** The United States reduced the so-called fentanyl-related tariff on Chinese goods from 20% to 10% and extended a suspension of higher reciprocal tariff rates. Existing tariffs from earlier years, including Section 301 duties, largely remained in place.
segments.tr: - **Tariffs.** Os Estados Unidos reduziram a chamada tarifa relacionada ao fentanil sobre produtos chineses de 20% para 10% e prorrogaram a suspensão de taxas tarifárias recíprocas mais altas. Tarifas existentes de anos anteriores, incluindo direitos da Seção 301, permaneceram amplamente em vigor.

segments.src: - **Rare earths.** China agreed to suspend the sweeping export-control measures it announced in October 2025 and to issue general licenses for certain materials. Earlier licensing requirements introduced in April 2025 stayed in force, so the system was eased rather than removed.
segments.tr: - **Rare earths.** A China concordou em suspender as amplas medidas de controle de exportação anunciadas em outubro de 2025 e em emitir licenças gerais para certos materiais. Requisitos de licenciamento anteriores introduzidos em abril de 2025 permaneceram em vigor, de modo que o sistema foi flexibilizado em vez de removido.

segments.src: - **Agricultural purchases.** China committed to resume large-scale purchases of U.S. soybeans, with a stated target of about 12 million metric tons in late 2025 and 25 million metric tons annually in the following years.
segments.tr: - **Agricultural purchases.** A China comprometeu-se a retomar compras em grande escala de soja dos EUA, com uma meta declarada de cerca de 12 milhões de toneladas métricas no final de 2025 e 25 milhões de toneladas métricas anualmente nos anos seguintes.

segments.src: - **Other pauses.** Both sides suspended some recently introduced measures, including certain port fees on ships and a U.S. rule that would have extended export restrictions to subsidiaries of listed companies.
segments.tr: - **Other pauses.** Ambos os lados suspenderam algumas medidas introduzidas recentemente, incluindo certas taxas portuárias sobre navios e uma regra dos EUA que teria estendido restrições de exportação a subsidiárias de empresas listadas.

segments.tr: ## O que cada lado entregou

segments.tr: Avaliar a conformidade é mais difícil do que parece, porque os compromissos foram descritos em termos gerais e a verificação depende de dados comerciais publicados com atraso.

segments.tr: As compras são tipicamente feitas por compradores ligados ao estado, e o timing segue padrões sazonais: a temporada de colheita e exportação

segments.tr: dos EUA corre principalmente do outono ao inverno, enquanto o Brasil domina as importações chinesas no primeiro semestre do ano.

segments.src: Because of that seasonality, a full-year tally is more meaningful than any single month.
segments.tr: Devido a essa sazonalidade, uma contagem de ano inteiro é mais significativa do que qualquer mês isolado.

segments.src: Analysts have also noted that the 25-million-ton annual figure is below the volumes China bought from the United States in the years before the trade war, so meeting it would be a partial recovery, not a return to the old baseline.
segments.tr: Analistas também observaram que o valor anual de 25 milhões de toneladas está abaixo dos volumes que a China comprou dos Estados Unidos nos anos anteriores à guerra comercial, então alcançá-lo seria uma recuperação parcial, não um retorno à antiga linha de base.

segments.src: **On rare earths,** the practical test is whether exporters can obtain licenses reliably and quickly.
segments.tr: **On rare earths,** o teste prático é se os exportadores conseguem obter licenças de forma confiável e rápida.

segments.src: Companies in automotive and electronics supply chains have reported that approvals and delivery times matter as much as the formal rules.
segments.tr: Empresas nas cadeias de suprimentos automotivas e de eletrônicos relataram que aprovações e tempos de entrega importam tanto quanto as regras formais.

segments.src: Even with general licenses, China retains the ability to slow or tighten approvals, which is why many manufacturers continue to look for alternative sources.
segments.tr: Mesmo com licenças gerais, a China retém a capacidade de desacelerar ou apertar aprovações, razão pela qual muitos fabricantes continuam a procurar fontes alternativas.

segments.src: **On tariffs,** the United States has kept the reduced rates in place during the truce period, though other tariff actions, including sector-specific measures and legal challenges to the use of emergency powers for tariffs, have continued to shape the broader picture.
segments.tr: **On tariffs,** os Estados Unidos mantiveram as taxas reduzidas em vigor durante o período de tregua, embora outras ações tarifárias, incluindo medidas específicas do setor e contestações legais ao uso de poderes de emergência para tarifas, tenham continuado a moldar o cenário mais amplo.

segments.src: ## What remains unresolved
segments.tr: ## O que permanece não resolvido

segments.src: Several issues were deliberately left for later:
segments.tr: Várias questões foram deixadas deliberadamente para depois:

segments.src: 1. **Technology controls.** Restrictions on advanced semiconductors and chipmaking equipment remain a central point of friction. Each side's decisions in this area can trigger responses elsewhere.
segments.tr: 1. **Technology controls.** Restrições a semicondutores avançados e equipamentos de fabricação de chips continuam sendo um ponto central de atrito. As decisões de cada lado nesta área podem desencadear respostas em outros lugares.

segments.src: 2. **Structural concerns.** U.S. officials continue to raise questions about industrial subsidies, overcapacity and market access. Chinese officials point to U.S. tariffs and export restrictions as barriers to normal trade.
segments.tr: 2. **Structural concerns.** Autoridades dos EUA continuam a levantar questões sobre subsídios industriais, excesso de capacidade e acesso ao mercado. Autoridades chinesas apontam para tarifas e restrições de exportação dos EUA como barreiras ao comércio normal.

segments.src: 3. **Legal uncertainty.** Court rulings on the authority behind some U.S. tariffs could change the tools available to the administration, even if the political deal holds.
segments.tr: 3. **Legal uncertainty.** Decisões judiciais sobre a autoridade por trás de algumas tarifas dos EUA poderiam alterar as ferramentas disponíveis para a administração, mesmo que o acordo político se sustente.

segments.src: 4. **Durability.** A one-year arrangement invites a recurring cliff. Companies must decide whether to treat the current rates as a stable base or as a temporary window.
segments.tr: 4. **Durability.** Um acordo de um ano convida a um precipício recorrente. As empresas devem decidir se tratam as taxas atuais como uma base estável ou como uma janela temporária.

segments.src: ## Scenarios: extension, breakdown or something in between
segments.tr: ## Cenários: prorrogação, colapso ou algo intermediário

segments.src: **Extension or a broader follow-up deal.** If both governments prolong the pause, the most likely effect is continuity: current tariff levels stay roughly in place, rare-earth licensing continues, and importers keep planning around today's costs.
segments.tr: **Extension or a broader follow-up deal.** Se ambos os governos prolongarem a pausa, o efeito mais provável é a continuidade: os níveis tarifários atuais permanecem aproximadamente no lugar, o licenciamento de terras raras continua, e os importadores continuam planejando em torno dos custos de hoje.

segments.src: A longer horizon would make it easier for businesses to commit to inventory and sourcing decisions, though it would not erase the tariffs that already exist.
segments.tr: Um horizonte mais longo facilitaria para as empresas se comprometerem com decisões de estoque e fornecimento, embora não apagasse as tarifas que já existem.

segments.src: **Partial lapse or selective tightening.** A middle path could involve some measures returning while others are kept in place.
segments.tr: **Partial lapse or selective tightening.** Um caminho do meio poderia envolver algumas medidas retornando enquanto outras são mantidas no lugar.

segments.src: This would likely produce uneven effects across industries.
segments.tr: Isso provavelmente produziria efeitos desiguais entre as indústrias.

segments.src: Sectors reliant on rare-earth inputs or on specific agricultural exports would be especially sensitive.
segments.tr: Setores dependentes de insumos de terras raras ou de exportações agrícolas específicas seriam especialmente sensíveis.

segments.src: **Breakdown.** If suspended measures snapped back, the effects would likely appear first in sentiment and shipping decisions, then in prices.
segments.tr: **Breakdown.** Se as medidas suspensas retornassem abruptamente, os efeitos provavelmente apareceriam primeiro no sentimento e nas decisões de envio, depois nos preços.

segments.src: Higher tariffs usually raise costs for importers, who may absorb them, pass them to consumers or change suppliers.
segments.tr: Tarifas mais altas geralmente aumentam os custos para os importadores, que podem absorvê-los, repassá-los aos consumidores ou mudar de fornecedor.

segments.src: Renewed rare-earth restrictions could affect production schedules for magnets and related components, with delays reaching manufacturers months later.
segments.tr: Restrições renovadas de terras raras poderiam afetar cronogramas de produção para ímãs e componentes relacionados, com atrasos atingindo os fabricantes meses depois.

segments.src: Farmers would face renewed uncertainty about one of their largest export markets.
segments.tr: Os agricultores enfrentariam incerteza renovada sobre um de seus maiores mercados de exportação.

segments.src: ## What it means for prices and supply chains
segments.tr: ## O que isso significa para preços e cadeias de suprimentos

segments.src: - **Consumers.** Tariff costs are only one part of retail prices, and effects vary by product. Categories with high import shares from China, such as some electronics, appliances and toys, are more exposed to rate changes than others.
segments.tr: - **Consumers.** Os custos tarifários são apenas uma parte dos preços de varejo, e os efeitos variam por produto. Categorias com altas participações de importação da China, como alguns eletrônicos, eletrodomésticos e brinquedos, estão mais expostas a mudanças de taxas do que outras.

segments.src: - **Manufacturers.** Many firms have spent the past year diversifying suppliers, building inventory buffers or shifting some assembly to other countries. These adjustments reduce but do not eliminate exposure, particularly for specialized inputs where few alternatives exist.
segments.tr: - **Manufacturers.** Muitas firmas passaram o último ano diversificando fornecedores, construindo amortecedores de estoque ou transferindo parte da montagem para outros países. Esses ajustes reduzem, mas não eliminam a exposição, particularmente para insumos especializados onde existem poucas alternativas.

segments.src: - **Farmers and agribusiness.** Soybean prices and export demand are sensitive to Chinese buying. Steady purchases support farm incomes, while disruptions tend to push growers toward other markets and lower-priced sales.
segments.tr: - **Farmers and agribusiness.** Os preços da soja e a demanda de exportação são sensíveis às compras chinesas. Compras constantes apoiam a renda agrícola, enquanto rupturas tendem a empurrar os produtores para outros mercados e vendas a preços mais baixos.

segments.src: - **Investors and businesses.** Currency movements, shipping rates and commodity prices often react to trade headlines. Long-term planning typically depends less on any single announcement than on whether rules appear stable.
segments.tr: - **Investors and businesses.** Movimentos cambiais, taxas de frete e preços de commodities frequentemente reagem às manchetes comerciais. O planejamento de longo prazo tipicamente depende menos de qualquer anúncio individual do que de se as regras parecem estáveis.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## O que observar a seguir

segments.src: - Official statements from the White House, the U.S. Trade Representative and China's Ministry of Commerce on any extension or new talks
segments.tr: - Declarações oficiais da Casa Branca, do Representante Comercial dos EUA e do Ministério do Comércio da China sobre qualquer prorrogação ou novas negociações

segments.tr: - Dados alfandegários mensais sobre remessas de soja e exportações de ímãs de terras raras

segments.tr: - Mudanças nas regras de exportação relacionadas a chips de qualquer um dos governos

segments.src: - Court decisions affecting U.S. tariff authority
segments.tr: - Decisões judiciais afetando a autoridade tarifária dos EUA

segments.src: - Company earnings commentary on costs, sourcing and lead times
segments.tr: - Comentários sobre lucros de empresas sobre custos, sourcing e prazos de entrega

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## A linha de fundo

segments.src: The truce bought time rather than a settlement.
segments.tr: A tregua comprou tempo em vez de um acordo definitivo.

segments.src: Its first year showed that both governments can lower tensions when they choose to, and that the arrangement depends on follow-through that is hard to measure from outside.
segments.tr: Seu primeiro ano mostrou que ambos os governos podem baixar as tensões quando escolhem fazê-lo, e que o acordo depende de um seguimento que é difícil de medir de fora.

segments.src: Whether it is extended, rebuilt or allowed to expire, the outcome will shape costs and planning for households, farms and factories well beyond the two capitals involved.
segments.tr: Seja prorrogado, reconstruído ou deixado expirar, o resultado moldará custos e planejamento para famílias, fazendas e fábricas muito além das duas capitais envolvidas.
