segments.tr: 2. **Structural concerns.** Pejabat AS terus mengajukan pertanyaan tentang subsidi industri, kelebihan kapasitas, dan akses pasar. Pejabat Tiongkok menunjuk pada tarif AS dan pembatasan ekspor sebagai hambatan untuk perdagangan normal.

segments.src: 3. **Legal uncertainty.** Court rulings on the authority behind some U.S. tariffs could change the tools available to the administration, even if the political deal holds.
segments.tr: 3. **Legal uncertainty.** Putusan pengadilan tentang otoritas di balik beberapa tarif AS dapat mengubah alat yang tersedia untuk administrasi, bahkan jika kesepakatan politik bertahan.

segments.src: 4. **Durability.** A one-year arrangement invites a recurring cliff. Companies must decide whether to treat the current rates as a stable base or as a temporary window.
segments.tr: 4. **Durability.** Pengaturan satu tahun mengundang jurang berulang. Perusahaan harus memutuskan apakah akan memperlakukan tarif saat ini sebagai dasar yang stabil atau sebagai jendela sementara.

segments.src: ## Scenarios: extension, breakdown or something in between
segments.tr: ## Skenario: perpanjangan, kerusakan, atau sesuatu di antaranya

segments.src: **Extension or a broader follow-up deal.** If both governments prolong the pause, the most likely effect is continuity: current tariff levels stay roughly in place, rare-earth licensing continues, and importers keep planning around today's costs.
segments.tr: **Extension or a broader follow-up deal.** Jika kedua pemerintah memperpanjang jeda, efek yang paling mungkin adalah kontinuitas: tingkat tarif saat ini tetap berada di tempatnya, perizinan tanah jarang berlanjut, dan importir terus merencanakan sekitar biaya hari ini.

segments.src: A longer horizon would make it easier for businesses to commit to inventory and sourcing decisions, though it would not erase the tariffs that already exist.
segments.tr: Cakrawala yang lebih lama akan memudahkan bisnis untuk berkomitmen pada keputusan inventaris dan sumber, meskipun itu tidak akan menghapus tarif yang sudah ada.

segments.src: **Partial lapse or selective tightening.** A middle path could involve some measures returning while others are kept in place.
segments.tr: **Partial lapse or selective tightening.** Jalur tengah dapat melibatkan beberapa tindakan yang dikembalikan sementara yang lain tetap di tempatnya.

segments.src: This would likely produce uneven effects across industries.
segments.tr: Ini kemungkinan akan menghasilkan efek yang tidak merata di berbagai industri.

segments.src: Sectors reliant on rare-earth inputs or on specific agricultural exports would be especially sensitive.
segments.tr: Sektor yang bergantung pada input tanah jarang atau pada ekspor pertanian tertentu akan sangat sensitif.

segments.src: **Breakdown.** If suspended measures snapped back, the effects would likely appear first in sentiment and shipping decisions, then in prices.
segments.tr: **Breakdown.** Jika tindakan yang ditangguhkan kembali, efeknya kemungkinan akan muncul pertama kali dalam sentimen dan keputusan pengiriman, kemudian dalam harga.

segments.src: Higher tariffs usually raise costs for importers, who may absorb them, pass them to consumers or change suppliers.
segments.tr: Tarif yang lebih tinggi biasanya menaikkan biaya bagi importir, yang dapat menyerapnya, meneruskannya ke konsumen, atau mengubah pemasok.

segments.src: Renewed rare-earth restrictions could affect production schedules for magnets and related components, with delays reaching manufacturers months later.
segments.tr: Pembatasan tanah jarang yang diperbarui dapat memengaruhi jadwal produksi untuk magnet dan komponen terkait, dengan penundaan mencapai produsen berbulan-bulan kemudian.

segments.src: Farmers would face renewed uncertainty about one of their largest export markets.
segments.tr: Petani akan menghadapi ketidakpastian yang diperbarui tentang salah satu pasar ekspor terbesar mereka.

segments.src: ## What it means for prices and supply chains
segments.tr: ## Apa artinya bagi harga dan rantai pasokan

segments.src: - **Consumers.** Tariff costs are only one part of retail prices, and effects vary by product. Categories with high import shares from China, such as some electronics, appliances and toys, are more exposed to rate changes than others.
segments.tr: - **Consumers.** Biaya tarif hanyalah salah satu bagian dari harga eceran, dan efeknya bervariasi menurut produk. Kategori dengan pangsa impor yang tinggi dari Tiongkok, seperti beberapa elektronik, peralatan, dan mainan, lebih rentan terhadap perubahan tarif daripada yang lain.

segments.src: - **Manufacturers.** Many firms have spent the past year diversifying suppliers, building inventory buffers or shifting some assembly to other countries. These adjustments reduce but do not eliminate exposure, particularly for specialized inputs where few alternatives exist.
segments.tr: - **Manufacturers.** Banyak perusahaan telah menghabiskan tahun lalu untuk mendiversifikasi pemasok, membangun penyangga inventaris, atau mengalihkan beberapa perakitan ke negara lain. Penyesuaian ini mengurangi tetapi tidak menghilangkan paparan, terutama untuk input khusus di mana hanya sedikit alternatif yang ada.

segments.src: - **Farmers and agribusiness.** Soybean prices and export demand are sensitive to Chinese buying. Steady purchases support farm incomes, while disruptions tend to push growers toward other markets and lower-priced sales.
segments.tr: - **Farmers and agribusiness.** Harga kedelai dan permintaan ekspor sensitif terhadap pembelian Tiongkok. Pembelian yang stabil mendukung pendapatan pertanian, sementara gangguan cenderung mendorong petani menuju pasar lain dan penjualan dengan harga lebih rendah.

segments.src: - **Investors and businesses.** Currency movements, shipping rates and commodity prices often react to trade headlines. Long-term planning typically depends less on any single announcement than on whether rules appear stable.
segments.tr: - **Investors and businesses.** Pergerakan mata uang, tarif pengiriman, dan harga komoditas sering bereaksi terhadap tajuk utama perdagangan. Perencanaan jangka panjang biasanya bergantung lebih sedikit pada pengumuman tunggal daripada apakah aturan tampak stabil.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## Apa yang harus ditonton selanjutnya

segments.tr: - Pernyataan resmi dari Gedung Putih, Perwakilan Dagang AS, dan Kementerian Perdagangan Tiongkok tentang perpanjangan atau pembicaraan baru

segments.src: - Monthly customs data on soybean shipments and rare-earth magnet exports
segments.tr: - Data bea cukai bulanan tentang pengiriman kedelai dan ekspor magnet tanah jarang

segments.src: - Changes to chip-related export rules from either government
segments.tr: - Perubahan aturan ekspor terkait cip dari salah satu pemerintah

segments.src: - Court decisions affecting U.S. tariff authority
segments.tr: - Keputusan pengadilan yang memengaruhi otoritas tarif AS

segments.src: - Company earnings commentary on costs, sourcing and lead times
segments.tr: - Komentar pendapatan perusahaan tentang biaya, sumber, dan waktu tunggu

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Intinya

segments.src: The truce bought time rather than a settlement.
segments.tr: Gencatan senjata membeli waktu alih-alih penyelesaian.

segments.src: Its first year showed that both governments can lower tensions when they choose to, and that the arrangement depends on follow-through that is hard to measure from outside.
segments.tr: Tahun pertamanya menunjukkan bahwa kedua pemerintah dapat menurunkan ketegangan ketika mereka memilih untuk melakukannya, dan bahwa pengaturan tersebut bergantung pada tindak lanjut yang sulit diukur dari luar.

segments.src: Whether it is extended, rebuilt or allowed to expire, the outcome will shape costs and planning for households, farms and factories well beyond the two capitals involved.
segments.tr: Apakah itu diperpanjang, dibangun kembali, atau dibiarkan kedaluwarsa, hasilnya akan membentuk biaya dan perencanaan bagi rumah tangga, pertanian, dan pabrik jauh melampaui kedua ibu kota yang terlibat.

ja.title: 休戦から1年：米中貿易デタントの行方とリスク

segments.src: When President Donald Trump and President Xi Jinping met in Busan, South Korea, on October 30, 2025, the two sides agreed to a one-year pause in several of their sharpest trade measures.
segments.tr: ドナルド・トランプ大統領と習近平国家主席が2025年10月30日に韓国・釜山で会談した際、両国は最も先鋭的な貿易措置のいくつかについて1年間の停止に合意した。

segments.src: The arrangement took effect in November 2025.
segments.tr: この取り決めは2025年11月に発効した。

segments.src: Now that the first anniversary has passed, attention has turned to a simple question: **will the pause be extended, reshaped, or allowed to lapse?**
segments.tr: 最初の記念日が過ぎた今、関心は単純な疑問に向けられている：**この一時停止は延長されるのか、見直されるのか、それとも失効に任せられるのか？**

segments.src: This article summarizes what the truce covered, what each side has done under it, which issues remain open, and how different outcomes could affect prices and supply chains.
segments.tr: この記事では、休戦の対象範囲、各国のこれまでの対応、未解決のまま残されている問題、そしてさまざまな結果が価格やサプライチェーンにどのような影響を与えるかをまとめている。

segments.src: Trade policy changes quickly, so check official announcements for the latest status.
segments.tr: 貿易政策は急速に変化するため、最新の状況については公式発表を確認してほしい。

segments.src: ## Why the truce mattered
segments.tr: ## なぜ休戦が重要だったのか

segments.src: Through 2025, tariffs and export restrictions between the world's two largest economies escalated in steps.
segments.tr: 2025年を通じて、世界最大の2つの経済大国間の関税および輸出規制は段階的にエスカレートした。

segments.src: Tariff rates on many goods climbed to levels that analysts warned could effectively halt trade in affected categories.
segments.tr: 多くの商品の関税率は、対象分野の貿易事実上停止させる恐れがあるとアナリストが警告する水準まで上昇した。

segments.src: China also announced broader controls on rare-earth materials and related technologies, which are essential to magnets used in electric vehicles, wind turbines, electronics and defense equipment.
segments.tr: 中国はまた、希土類（レアアース）素材および関連技術に対するより広範な規制を発表した。これらは電気自動車、風力タービン、電子機器、防衛装備品に使用される磁石に不可欠なものである。

segments.src: The Busan arrangement did not resolve the underlying disagreements.
segments.tr: 釜山の取り決めは根本的な意見の不一致を解決するものではなかった。

segments.src: It lowered the temperature, giving businesses a more predictable window for planning.
segments.tr: それは緊張を和らげ、企業により予測可能な計画のための期間を与えた。

segments.src: That predictability is the main thing at stake now.
segments.tr: その予測可能性こそが、今まさに懸かっている最大の要素である。

segments.src: ## What the truce covered
segments.tr: ## 休戦の対象範囲

segments.src: The main elements, as announced by both governments in late 2025, were:
segments.tr: 2025年後半に両政府が発表した主な内容は以下の通りである：

segments.src: - **Tariffs.** The United States reduced the so-called fentanyl-related tariff on Chinese goods from 20% to 10% and extended a suspension of higher reciprocal tariff rates. Existing tariffs from earlier years, including Section 301 duties, largely remained in place.
segments.tr: - **関税。** 米国は中国製品に対するいわゆるフェンタニル関連関税を20%から10%に引き下げ、より高い相互関税率の一時停止を延長した。301条関税を含む過去数年間の既存の関税は概ね据え置かれた。

segments.src: - **Rare earths.** China agreed to suspend the sweeping export-control measures it announced in October 2025 and to issue general licenses for certain materials. Earlier licensing requirements introduced in April 2025 stayed in force, so the system was eased rather than removed.
segments.tr: - **レアアース。** 中国は2025年10月に発表した徹底的な輸出管理措置を一時停止し、特定の素材に対する一般ライセンスを発行することに合意した。2025年4月に導入された従来のライセンス要件は効力を維持したため、システムは撤廃というよりは緩和された形となった。

segments.src: - **Agricultural purchases.** China committed to resume large-scale purchases of U.S. soybeans, with a stated target of about 12 million metric tons in late 2025 and 25 million metric tons annually in the following years.
segments.tr: - **農産物の購入。** 中国は米国の大豆の大規模購入を再開することを確約し、2025年後半に約1,200万メートルトン、その後の数年間は年2500万メートルトンを目標とすることを掲げた。

segments.src: - **Other pauses.** Both sides suspended some recently introduced measures, including certain port fees on ships and a U.S. rule that would have extended export restrictions to subsidiaries of listed companies.
segments.tr: - **その他の停止措置。** 両国は、船舶に対する特定の港湾使用料や、上場企業の傘下企業にまで輸出規制を拡大する予定だった米国の規則など、最近導入されたいくつかの措置を一時停止した。

segments.src: ## What each side has delivered
segments.tr: ## 各国の対応状況

segments.src: Assessing compliance is harder than it sounds, because the commitments were described in general terms and verification relies on trade data that is published with a delay.
segments.tr: コミットメントが一般的な表現で説明されており、検証が遅れて公開される貿易データに依存しているため、遵守状況の評価は見た目よりも難しい。

segments.src: **On soybeans,** the key metrics are monthly customs data and U.S.
segments.tr: **大豆について、**主要な指標は月次税関データおよび米国

segments.src: Department of Agriculture export reports.
segments.tr: 農務省の輸出報告書である。

segments.src: Purchases are typically made by state-linked buyers, and timing follows seasonal patterns: the U.S.
segments.tr: 購入は通常、国家に関連する買い手によって行われ、時期は季節のパターンに従う。米国の

segments.src: harvest and export season runs mainly from autumn through winter, while Brazil dominates Chinese imports in the first half of the year.
segments.tr: 収穫・輸出シーズンは主に秋から冬にかけてであり、一方ブラジルは上半期の中国の輸入を支配している。

segments.src: Because of that seasonality, a full-year tally is more meaningful than any single month.
segments.tr: そのような季節性があるため、単月の数値よりも年間トータルのほうが意味がある。

segments.src: Analysts have also noted that the 25-million-ton annual figure is below the volumes China bought from the United States in the years before the trade war, so meeting it would be a partial recovery, not a return to the old baseline.
segments.tr: アナリストはまた、2500万トンという年間数値は貿易戦争前の数年間に中国が米国から購入した数量を下回っているため、それを達成しても古い基準への復帰ではなく、部分的な回復に過ぎないと指摘している。

segments.src: **On rare earths,** the practical test is whether exporters can obtain licenses reliably and quickly.
segments.tr: **レアアースについて、**実践的なテストは、輸出しが信頼性と迅速性をもってライセンスを取得できるかどうかである。

segments.src: Companies in automotive and electronics supply chains have reported that approvals and delivery times matter as much as the formal rules.
segments.tr: 自動車および電子機器のサプライチェーンの企業は、承認と配送時間が正式な規則と同じくらい重要であると報告している。

segments.src: Even with general licenses, China retains the ability to slow or tighten approvals, which is why many manufacturers continue to look for alternative sources.
segments.tr: 一般ライセンスがあったとしても、中国は承認を遅らせたり厳格化したりする能力を維持しており、それが多くのメーカーが代替調達先を探し続ける理由である。

segments.src: **On tariffs,** the United States has kept the reduced rates in place during the truce period, though other tariff actions, including sector-specific measures and legal challenges to the use of emergency powers for tariffs, have continued to shape the broader picture.
segments.tr: **関税について、**米国は休戦期間中も引き下げられた税率を維持しているが、セクター別の措置や関税への大統領緊急権限の行使に対する法的挑戦など、他の関税の動きがより大きな全体像を形成し続けている。

segments.src: ## What remains unresolved
segments.tr: ## 未解決のまま残されている問題

segments.src: Several issues were deliberately left for later:
segments.tr: いくつかの問題は意図的に後回しにされた：

segments.src: 1. **Technology controls.** Restrictions on advanced semiconductors and chipmaking equipment remain a central point of friction. Each side's decisions in this area can trigger responses elsewhere.
segments.tr: 1. **技術管理。** 高度な半導体やチップ製造装置に対する規制は依然として摩擦の中心点である。この分野における各国の決定は、他の場所での対応を引き起こす可能性がある。

segments.src: 2. **Structural concerns.** U.S. officials continue to raise questions about industrial subsidies, overcapacity and market access. Chinese officials point to U.S. tariffs and export restrictions as barriers to normal trade.
segments.tr: 2. **構造的懸念。** 米国当局者は産業補助金、過剰生産能力、市場アクセスに関する疑問を提起し続けている。中国当局者は通常の貿易に対する障壁として米国の関税と輸出規制を指摘している。

segments.src: 3. **Legal uncertainty.** Court rulings on the authority behind some U.S. tariffs could change the tools available to the administration, even if the political deal holds.
segments.tr: 3. **法的不確実性。** 一部の米国の関税の背後にある権限に関する裁判所の判決は、政治的合意が維持されたとしても、政権が利用できるツールを変える可能性がある。

segments.src: 4. **Durability.** A one-year arrangement invites a recurring cliff. Companies must decide whether to treat the current rates as a stable base or as a temporary window.
segments.tr: 4. **持続性。** 1年間の取り決めは、繰り返される崖を生む。企業は現在の税率を安定したベースとして扱うべきか、それとも一時的な窓口として扱うべきかを決定しなければならない。

segments.src: ## Scenarios: extension, breakdown or something in between
segments.tr: ## シナリオ：延長、決裂、あるいはその中間の何か

segments.src: **Extension or a broader follow-up deal.** If both governments prolong the pause, the most likely effect is continuity: current tariff levels stay roughly in place, rare-earth licensing continues, and importers keep planning around today's costs.
segments.tr: **延長またはより広範なフォローアップ合意。** 両政府が一時停止を長引かせる場合、最も可能性の高い影響は継続性である。現在の関税水準はほぼ維持され、レアアースのライセンス発行が続き、輸入業者は今日のコストを前提に計画を立て続ける。

segments.src: A longer horizon would make it easier for businesses to commit to inventory and sourcing decisions, though it would not erase the tariffs that already exist.
segments.tr: より長いスパンがあれば、企業が在庫や調達の決定にコミットしやすくなるが、すでに存在する関税が消えるわけではない。

segments.src: **Partial lapse or selective tightening.** A middle path could involve some measures returning while others are kept in place.
segments.tr: **部分的な失効または選択的な引き締め。** 中間的な道には、一部の措置が復活する一方で他の措置が維持されるというものがあり得る。

segments.src: This would likely produce uneven effects across industries.
segments.tr: これにより、産業全体で不均一な影響が生じる可能性が高い。

segments.src: Sectors reliant on rare-earth inputs or on specific agricultural exports would be especially sensitive.
segments.tr: レアアースの投入や特定の農産物輸出に依存するセクターは特に敏感になるだろう。

segments.src: **Breakdown.** If suspended measures snapped back, the effects would likely appear first in sentiment and shipping decisions, then in prices.
segments.tr: **決裂。** 停止された措置が突然復活した場合、その影響はおそらくセンチメントや出荷の決定に最初に表れ、次に価格に表れるだろう。

segments.src: Higher tariffs usually raise costs for importers, who may absorb them, pass them to consumers or change suppliers.
segments.tr: より高い関税は通常、輸入業者のコストを上昇させ、彼らはそれを吸収するか、消費者転嫁するか、あるいはサプライヤーを変更する可能性がある。

segments.src: Renewed rare-earth restrictions could affect production schedules for magnets and related components, with delays reaching manufacturers months later.
segments.tr: 新たなレアアース規制は磁石や関連部品の生産スケジュールに影響を与える可能性があり、遅れは数ヶ月後にメーカーに届くことになる。

segments.src: Farmers would face renewed uncertainty about one of their largest export markets.
segments.tr: 農家は最大の輸出市場の1つに関する新たな不確実性に直面することになるだろう。

segments.src: ## What it means for prices and supply chains
segments.tr: ## 価格とサプライチェーンにとっての意味

segments.src: - **Consumers.** Tariff costs are only one part of retail prices, and effects vary by product. Categories with high import shares from China, such as some electronics, appliances and toys, are more exposed to rate changes than others.
segments.tr: - **消費者。** 関税コストは小売価格の一部に過ぎず、影響は製品によって異なる。一部の電子機器、家電製品、おもちゃなど、中国からの輸入割合が高いカテゴリーは、他のカテゴリーよりも税率変更にさらされやすい。

segments.src: - **Manufacturers.** Many firms have spent the past year diversifying suppliers, building inventory buffers or shifting some assembly to other countries. These adjustments reduce but do not eliminate exposure, particularly for specialized inputs where few alternatives exist.
segments.tr: - **メーカー。** 多くの企業は過去1年間、サプライヤーの多様化、在庫バッファの構築、あるいは一部の組み立ての他国への移転に費やしてきた。これらの調整は曝露を減少させるが、代替案がほとんどない特殊な投入物については特に、それを完全になくすことはできない。

segments.src: - **Farmers and agribusiness.** Soybean prices and export demand are sensitive to Chinese buying. Steady purchases support farm incomes, while disruptions tend to push growers toward other markets and lower-priced sales.
segments.tr: - **農家およびアグリビジネス。** 大豆の価格と輸出需要は中国の買い付けに敏感である。安定した購入は農家の収入を支える一方、混乱は生産者を他の市場や低価格の販売へと向かわせる傾向がある。

segments.src: - **Investors and businesses.** Currency movements, shipping rates and commodity prices often react to trade headlines. Long-term planning typically depends less on any single announcement than on whether rules appear stable.
segments.tr: - **投資家と企業。** 為替レート、輸送費、コモディティ価格はしばしば貿易の見出しに反応する。長期的な計画は、単一の発表よりも、規則が安定しているように見えるかどうかに依存することが多い。

segments.src: ## What to watch next

de.title: Ein Jahr nach dem Waffenstillstand: Was bei der Handelsentspannung zwischen den USA und China auf dem Spiel steht

segments.src: When President Donald Trump and President Xi Jinping met in Busan, South Korea, on October 30, 2025, the two sides agreed to a one-year pause in several of their sharpest trade measures.
segments.tr: Als Präsident Donald Trump und Präsident Xi Jinping am 30. Oktober 2025 in Busan, Südkorea, zusammentrafen, einigten sich beide Seiten auf eine einjährige Pause bei mehreren ihrer schärfsten Handelsmaßnahmen.

segments.src: The arrangement took effect in November 2025.
segments.tr: Die Vereinbarung trat im November 2025 in Kraft.

segments.src: Now that the first anniversary has passed, attention has turned to a simple question: **will the pause be extended, reshaped, or allowed to lapse?**
segments.tr: Nachdem nun der erste Jahrestag verstrichen ist, richtet sich die Aufmerksamkeit auf eine einfache Frage: **Wird die Pause verlängert, neu gestaltet oder auslaufen gelassen?**

segments.src: This article summarizes what the truce covered, what each side has done under it, which issues remain open, and how different outcomes could affect prices and supply chains.
segments.tr: Dieser Artikel fasst zusammen, was der Waffenstillstand abdeckte, was jede Seite im Rahmen dessen getan hat, welche Fragen offen bleiben und wie sich unterschiedliche Ergebnisse auf Preise und Lieferketten auswirken könnten.

segments.src: Trade policy changes quickly, so check official announcements for the latest status.
segments.tr: Die Handelspolitik ändert sich schnell, prüfen Sie daher offizielle Ankündigungen für den neuesten Stand.

segments.src: ## Why the truce mattered
segments.tr: ## Warum der Waffenstillstand wichtig war

segments.src: Through 2025, tariffs and export restrictions between the world's two largest economies escalated in steps.
segments.tr: Im Laufe des Jahres 2025 eskalierten Zölle und Exportbeschränkungen zwischen den beiden größten Volkswirtschaften der Welt schrittweise.

segments.src: Tariff rates on many goods climbed to levels that analysts warned could effectively halt trade in affected categories.
segments.tr: Die Zollsätze für viele Waren stiegen auf Niveaus, von denen Analysten warnten, dass sie den Handel in den betroffenen Kategorien effektiv zum Erliegen bringen könnten.

segments.src: China also announced broader controls on rare-earth materials and related technologies, which are essential to magnets used in electric vehicles, wind turbines, electronics and defense equipment.
segments.tr: China kündigte zudem umfassendere Kontrollen für Seltenerdmaterialien und verwandte Technologien an, die für Magnete in Elektrofahrzeugen, Windkraftanlagen, Elektronik und Verteidigungsausrüstung unerlässlich sind.

segments.src: The Busan arrangement did not resolve the underlying disagreements.
segments.tr: Die Vereinbarung von Busan löste die zugrunde liegenden Meinungsverschiedenheiten nicht.

segments.src: It lowered the temperature, giving businesses a more predictable window for planning.
segments.tr: Sie senkte die Spannungen und gab Unternehmen ein berechenbareres Zeitfenster für die Planung.

segments.src: That predictability is the main thing at stake now.
segments.tr: Diese Vorhersehbarkeit ist das, was jetzt hauptsächlich auf dem Spiel steht.

segments.src: ## What the truce covered
segments.tr: ## Was der Waffenstillstand abdeckte

segments.src: The main elements, as announced by both governments in late 2025, were:
segments.tr: Die Hauptelemente, wie sie von beiden Regierungen Ende 2025 bekannt gegeben wurden, waren:

segments.src: - **Tariffs.** The United States reduced the so-called fentanyl-related tariff on Chinese goods from 20% to 10% and extended a suspension of higher reciprocal tariff rates. Existing tariffs from earlier years, including Section 301 duties, largely remained in place.
segments.tr: - **Zölle.** Die Vereinigten Staaten senkten den sogenannten Fentanyl-bezogenen Zoll auf chinesische Waren von 20 % auf 10 % und verlängerten eine Aussetzung höherer gegenseitiger Zollsätze. Bestehende Zölle aus früheren Jahren, einschließlich der Zölle nach Section 301, blieben weitgehend in Kraft.

segments.src: - **Rare earths.** China agreed to suspend the sweeping export-control measures it announced in October 2025 and to issue general licenses for certain materials. Earlier licensing requirements introduced in April 2025 stayed in force, so the system was eased rather than removed.
segments.tr: - **Seltene Erden.** China stimmte zu, die umfassenden Exportkontrollmaßnahmen, die es im Oktober 2025 angekündigt hatte, auszusetzen und allgemeine Lizenzen für bestimmte Materialien auszustellen. Frühere Lizenzanforderungen, die im April 2025 eingeführt wurden, blieben in Kraft, sodass das System eher gelockert als abgeschafft wurde.

segments.src: - **Agricultural purchases.** China committed to resume large-scale purchases of U.S. soybeans, with a stated target of about 12 million metric tons in late 2025 and 25 million metric tons annually in the following years.
segments.tr: - **Agrarkäufe.** China verpflichtete sich, die groß angelegten Käufe von US-Sojabohnen wieder aufzunehmen, mit einem erklärten Ziel von etwa 12 Millionen Tonnen Ende 2025 und 25 Millionen Tonnen jährlich in den Folgejahren.

segments.src: - **Other pauses.** Both sides suspended some recently introduced measures, including certain port fees on ships and a U.S. rule that would have extended export restrictions to subsidiaries of listed companies.
segments.tr: - **Andere Pausen.** Beide Seiten setzten einige kürzlich eingeführte Maßnahmen aus, darunter bestimmte Hafengebühren für Schiffe und eine US-Regel, die Exportbeschränkungen auf Tochtergesellschaften börsennotierter Unternehmen ausgeweitet hätte.

segments.src: ## What each side has delivered
segments.tr: ## Was jede Seite geliefert hat

segments.src: Assessing compliance is harder than it sounds, because the commitments were described in general terms and verification relies on trade data that is published with a delay.
segments.tr: Die Bewertung der Einhaltung ist schwieriger als es klingt, da die Verpflichtungen in allgemeinen Begriffen beschrieben wurden und die Überprüfung auf Handelsdaten beruht, die mit Verzögerung veröffentlicht werden.

segments.src: **On soybeans,** the key metrics are monthly customs data and U.S.
segments.tr: **Bei Sojabohnen** sind die wichtigsten Kennzahlen monatliche Zolldaten und die Exportberichte des US-

segments.src: Department of Agriculture export reports.
segments.tr: Landwirtschaftsministeriums.

segments.src: Purchases are typically made by state-linked buyers, and timing follows seasonal patterns: the U.S.
segments.tr: Käufe werden typischerweise von staatlich verbundenen Käufern getätigt, und das Timing folgt saisonalen Mustern: Die US-

segments.src: harvest and export season runs mainly from autumn through winter, while Brazil dominates Chinese imports in the first half of the year.
segments.tr: Ernte- und Exportsaison läuft hauptsächlich vom Herbst bis zum Winter, während Brasilien in der ersten Jahreshälfte die chinesischen Importe dominiert.

segments.src: Because of that seasonality, a full-year tally is more meaningful than any single month.
segments.tr: Aufgrund dieser Saisonalität ist eine Ganzjahresbilanz aussagekräftiger als jeder einzelne Monat.

segments.src: Analysts have also noted that the 25-million-ton annual figure is below the volumes China bought from the United States in the years before the trade war, so meeting it would be a partial recovery, not a return to the old baseline.
segments.tr: Analysten haben auch angemerkt, dass die jährliche Zahl von 25 Millionen Tonnen unter den Mengen liegt, die China in den Jahren vor dem Handelskrieg aus den Vereinigten Staaten gekauft hat, sodass das Erreichen dieses Ziels eine teilweise Erholung wäre, keine Rückkehr zur alten Basis.

segments.src: **On rare earths,** the practical test is whether exporters can obtain licenses reliably and quickly.
segments.tr: **Bei Seltenen Erden** ist der praktische Test, ob Exporteure Lizenzen zuverlässig und schnell erhalten können.

segments.src: Companies in automotive and electronics supply chains have reported that approvals and delivery times matter as much as the formal rules.
segments.tr: Unternehmen in Lieferketten der Automobil- und Elektronikindustrie haben berichtet, dass Genehmigungen und Lieferzeiten genauso wichtig sind wie die formalen Regeln.

segments.src: Even with general licenses, China retains the ability to slow or tighten approvals, which is why many manufacturers continue to look for alternative sources.
segments.tr: Selbst mit allgemeinen Lizenzen behält China die Fähigkeit, Genehmigungen zu verlangsamen oder zu verschärfen, weshalb viele Hersteller weiterhin nach alternativen Quellen suchen.

segments.src: **On tariffs,** the United States has kept the reduced rates in place during the truce period, though other tariff actions, including sector-specific measures and legal challenges to the use of emergency powers for tariffs, have continued to shape the broader picture.
segments.tr: **Bei Zöllen** haben die Vereinigten Staaten die reduzierten Sätze während des Waffenstillstandszeitraums beibehalten, obwohl andere Zollmaßnahmen, einschließlich sektorspezifischer Maßnahmen und rechtlicher Anfechtungen der Nutzung von Notstandsbefugnissen für Zölle, weiterhin das Gesamtbild prägen.

segments.src: ## What remains unresolved
segments.tr: ## Was ungelöst bleibt

segments.src: Several issues were deliberately left for later:
segments.tr: Mehrere Themen wurden bewusst für später zurückgestellt:

segments.src: 1. **Technology controls.** Restrictions on advanced semiconductors and chipmaking equipment remain a central point of friction. Each side's decisions in this area can trigger responses elsewhere.
segments.tr: 1. **Technologiekontrollen.** Beschränkungen für fortschrittliche Halbleiter und Ausrüstung zur Chipherstellung bleiben ein zentraler Reibungspunkt. Die Entscheidungen jeder Seite in diesem Bereich können Reaktionen an anderer Stelle auslösen.

segments.src: 2. **Structural concerns.** U.S. officials continue to raise questions about industrial subsidies, overcapacity and market access. Chinese officials point to U.S. tariffs and export restrictions as barriers to normal trade.
segments.tr: 2. **Strukturelle Bedenken.** US-Beamte werfen weiterhin Fragen zu Industriesubventionen, Überkapazitäten und Marktzugang auf. Chinesische Beamte verweisen auf US-Zölle und Exportbeschränkungen als Hindernisse für den normalen Handel.

segments.src: 3. **Legal uncertainty.** Court rulings on the authority behind some U.S. tariffs could change the tools available to the administration, even if the political deal holds.
segments.tr: 3. **Rechtliche Unsicherheit.** Gerichtsurteile zur Befugnis hinter einigen US-Zöllen könnten die der Regierung zur Verfügung stehenden Instrumente verändern, selbst wenn das politische Abkommen hält.

segments.src: 4. **Durability.** A one-year arrangement invites a recurring cliff. Companies must decide whether to treat the current rates as a stable base or as a temporary window.
segments.tr: 4. **Dauerhaftigkeit.** Eine einjährige Vereinbarung lädt zu einer wiederkehrenden Klippe ein. Unternehmen müssen entscheiden, ob sie die aktuellen Sätze als stabile Basis oder als vorübergehendes Fenster betrachten.

segments.src: ## Scenarios: extension, breakdown or something in between
segments.tr: ## Szenarien: Verlängerung, Zusammenbruch oder etwas dazwischen

segments.src: **Extension or a broader follow-up deal.** If both governments prolong the pause, the most likely effect is continuity: current tariff levels stay roughly in place, rare-earth licensing continues, and importers keep planning around today's costs.
segments.tr: **Verlängerung oder ein breiteres Folgeabkommen.** Wenn beide Regierungen die Pause verlängern, ist die wahrscheinlichste Auswirkung Kontinuität: Die aktuellen Zollniveaus bleiben in etwa bestehen, die Lizenzierung für Seltene Erden wird fortgesetzt und Importeure planen weiterhin auf Basis der heutigen Kosten.

segments.src: A longer horizon would make it easier for businesses to commit to inventory and sourcing decisions, though it would not erase the tariffs that already exist.
segments.tr: Ein längerer Horizont würde es Unternehmen erleichtern, sich auf Bestands- und Beschaffungsentscheidungen festzulegen, obwohl dies die bereits bestehenden Zölle nicht auslöschen würde.

segments.src: **Partial lapse or selective tightening.** A middle path could involve some measures returning while others are kept in place.
segments.tr: **Teilweises Auslaufen oder selektive Verschärfung.** Ein Mittelweg könnte beinhalten, dass einige Maßnahmen zurückkehren, während andere beibehalten werden.

segments.src: This would likely produce uneven effects across industries.
segments.tr: Dies würde wahrscheinlich ungleichmäßige Auswirkungen auf die Branchen haben.

segments.src: Sectors reliant on rare-earth inputs or on specific agricultural exports would be especially sensitive.
segments.tr: Sektoren, die auf Vorleistungen aus Seltenen Erden oder auf bestimmte Agrarexporte angewiesen sind, wären besonders empfindlich.

segments.src: **Breakdown.** If suspended measures snapped back, the effects would likely appear first in sentiment and shipping decisions, then in prices.
segments.tr: **Zusammenbruch.** Wenn ausgesetzte Maßnahmen zurückkehren würden, würden sich die Auswirkungen wahrscheinlich zuerst in der Stimmung und bei Versandentscheidungen zeigen, dann bei den Preisen.

segments.src: Higher tariffs usually raise costs for importers, who may absorb them, pass them to consumers or change suppliers.
segments.tr: Höhere Zölle erhöhen normalerweise die Kosten für Importeure, die diese möglicherweise absorbieren, an Verbraucher weitergeben oder Lieferanten wechseln.

segments.src: Renewed rare-earth restrictions could affect production schedules for magnets and related components, with delays reaching manufacturers months later.
segments.tr: Erneute Beschränkungen für Seltene Erden könnten Produktionspläne für Magnete und verwandte Komponenten beeinträchtigen, wobei Verzögerungen die Hersteller Monate später erreichen würden.

segments.src: Farmers would face renewed uncertainty about one of their largest export markets.
segments.tr: Landwirte würden mit erneuter Unsicherheit über einen ihrer größten Exportmärkte konfrontiert.

segments.src: ## What it means for prices and supply chains
segments.tr: ## Was es für Preise und Lieferketten bedeutet

segments.src: - **Consumers.** Tariff costs are only one part of retail prices, and effects vary by product. Categories with high import shares from China, such as some electronics, appliances and toys, are more exposed to rate changes than others.
segments.tr: - **Verbraucher.** Zollkosten sind nur ein Teil der Einzelhandelspreise, und die Auswirkungen variieren je nach Produkt. Kategorien mit hohen Importanteilen aus China, wie einige Elektronikartikel, Haushaltsgeräte und Spielzeug, sind stärker von Ratenänderungen betroffen als andere.

segments.src: - **Manufacturers.** Many firms have spent the past year diversifying suppliers, building inventory buffers or shifting some assembly to other countries. These adjustments reduce but do not eliminate exposure, particularly for specialized inputs where few alternatives exist.
segments.tr: - **Hersteller.** Viele Firmen haben das letzte Jahr damit verbracht, Lieferanten zu diversifizieren, Lagerpuffer aufzubauen oder einen Teil der Montage in andere Länder zu verlagern. Diese Anpassungen reduzieren, eliminieren aber nicht die Exposition, insbesondere bei spezialisierten Vorleistungen, für die es nur wenige Alternativen gibt.

segments.src: - **Farmers and agribusiness.** Soybean prices and export demand are sensitive to Chinese buying. Steady purchases support farm incomes, while disruptions tend to push growers toward other markets and lower-priced sales.
segments.tr: - **Landwirte und Agrarindustrie.** Sojabohnenpreise und Exportnachfrage reagieren empfindlich auf chinesische Käufe. Stetige Käufe stützen das landwirtschaftliche Einkommen, während Störungen dazu neigen, Erzeuger zu anderen Märkten und preisgünstigeren Verkäufen zu drängen.

segments.src: - **Investors and businesses.** Currency movements, shipping rates and commodity prices often react to trade headlines. Long-term planning typically depends less on any single announcement than on whether rules appear stable.
segments.tr: - **Investoren und Unternehmen.** Währungsbewegungen, Versandraten und Rohstoffpreise reagieren oft auf Handelsüberschriften. Langfristige Planung hängt typischerweise weniger von einer einzelnen Ankündigung ab als davon, ob Regeln stabil erscheinen.

segments.tr: ## Was als Nächstes zu beobachten ist

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Das Fazit

segments.src: The truce bought time rather than a settlement.
segments.tr: Der Waffenstillstand hat Zeit gekauft, keine Einigung.

segments.src: Its first year showed that both governments can lower tensions when they choose to, and that the arrangement depends on follow-through that is hard to measure from outside.
segments.tr: Sein erstes Jahr hat gezeigt, dass beide Regierungen Spannungen abbauen können, wenn sie dies wollen, und dass die Vereinbarung von einer Umsetzung abhängt, die von außen schwer zu messen ist.

segments.src: ## What the truce covered
segments.tr: ## युद्धविराम में क्या शामिल था

segments.src: The main elements, as announced by both governments in late 2025, were:
segments.tr: 2025 के अंत में दोनों सरकारों द्वारा घोषित मुख्य तत्व थे:

segments.src: - **Tariffs.** The United States reduced the so-called fentanyl-related tariff on Chinese goods from 20% to 10% and extended a suspension of higher reciprocal tariff rates. Existing tariffs from earlier years, including Section 301 duties, largely remained in place.
segments.tr: - **टैरिफ।** संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका ने चीनी वस्तुओं पर तथाकथित फेंटानिल-संबंधित टैरिफ को 20% से घटाकर 10% कर दिया और उच्च पारस्परिक टैरिफ दरों के निलंबन को बढ़ा दिया। पिछले वर्षों के मौजूदा टैरिफ, जिसमें धारा 301 के शुल्क शामिल हैं, काफी हद तक लागू रहे।

segments.src: - **Rare earths.** China agreed to suspend the sweeping export-control measures it announced in October 2025 and to issue general licenses for certain materials. Earlier licensing requirements introduced in April 2025 stayed in force, so the system was eased rather than removed.
segments.tr: - **दुर्लभ पृथ्वी (Rare earths)।** चीन अक्टूबर 2025 में घोषित व्यापक निर्यात-नियंत्रण उपायों को निलंबित करने और कुछ सामग्रियों के लिए सामान्य लाइसेंस जारी करने पर सहमत हुआ। अप्रैल 2025 में शुरू की गई पिछली लाइसेंसिंग आवश्यकताएं लागू रहीं, इसलिए प्रणाली को हटाने के बजाय आसान बनाया गया था।

segments.src: - **Agricultural purchases.** China committed to resume large-scale purchases of U.S. soybeans, with a stated target of about 12 million metric tons in late 2025 and 25 million metric tons annually in the following years.
segments.tr: - **कृषि खरीद।** चीन ने अमेरिकी सोयाबीन की बड़े पैमाने पर खरीद फिर से शुरू करने के लिए प्रतिबद्धता जताई, जिसका निर्धारित लक्ष्य 2025 के अंत में लगभग 12 मिलियन मीट्रिक टन और आने वाले वर्षों में सालाना 25 मिलियन मीट्रिक टन था।

segments.src: - **Other pauses.** Both sides suspended some recently introduced measures, including certain port fees on ships and a U.S. rule that would have extended export restrictions to subsidiaries of listed companies.
segments.tr: - **अन्य विराम।** दोनों पक्षों ने हाल ही में शुरू किए गए कुछ उपायों को निलंबित कर दिया, जिसमें जहाजों पर कुछ बंदरगाह शुल्क और एक अमेरिकी नियम शामिल है जो सूचीबद्ध कंपनियों की सहायक कंपनियों तक निर्यात प्रतिबंधों का विस्तार करता।

segments.src: ## What each side has delivered
segments.tr: ## प्रत्येक पक्ष ने क्या पूरा किया

segments.tr: अनुपालन का आकलन करना सुनने में जितना आसान लगता है उससे कहीं अधिक कठिन है, क्योंकि प्रतिबद्धताओं का वर्णन सामान्य शब्दों में किया गया था और सत्यापन व्यापार डेटा पर निर्भर करता है जिसे देरी से प्रकाशित किया जाता है।

segments.src: **On soybeans,** the key metrics are monthly customs data and U.S.
segments.tr: **सोयाबीन पर,** प्रमुख मेट्रिक्स मासिक सीमा शुल्क डेटा और अमेरिकी

segments.src: Department of Agriculture export reports.
segments.tr: कृषि विभाग की निर्यात रिपोर्ट हैं।

segments.src: Purchases are typically made by state-linked buyers, and timing follows seasonal patterns: the U.S.
segments.tr: खरीद आमतौर पर राज्य-संबद्ध खरीदारों द्वारा की जाती है, और समय मौसमी पैटर्न का पालन करता है: अमेरिकी

segments.src: harvest and export season runs mainly from autumn through winter, while Brazil dominates Chinese imports in the first half of the year.
segments.tr: फसल और निर्यात का मौसम मुख्य रूप से शरद ऋतु से सर्दियों तक चलता है, जबकि ब्राजील वर्ष की पहली छमाही में चीनी आयात पर हावी रहता है।

segments.src: Because of that seasonality, a full-year tally is more meaningful than any single month.
segments.tr: उस मौसमी प्रभाव के कारण, किसी एक महीने की तुलना में पूरे वर्ष की गणना अधिक सार्थक है।

segments.src: Analysts have also noted that the 25-million-ton annual figure is below the volumes China bought from the United States in the years before the trade war, so meeting it would be a partial recovery, not a return to the old baseline.
segments.tr: विश्लेषकों ने यह भी नोट किया है कि 25-मिलियन-टन का वार्षिक आंकड़ा व्यापार युद्ध से पहले के वर्षों में चीन द्वारा अमेरिका से खरीदी गई मात्रा से कम है, इसलिए इसे पूरा करना एक आंशिक सुधार होगा, न कि पुराने आधार स्तर पर वापसी।

segments.src: **On rare earths,** the practical test is whether exporters can obtain licenses reliably and quickly.
segments.tr: **दुर्लभ पृथ्वी पर,** व्यावहारिक परीक्षण यह है कि क्या निर्यातक विश्वसनीय और तेजी से लाइसेंस प्राप्त कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: Companies in automotive and electronics supply chains have reported that approvals and delivery times matter as much as the formal rules.
segments.tr: ऑटोमोटिव और इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स आपूर्ति श्रृंखलाओं की कंपनियों ने बताया है कि अनुमोदन और डिलीवरी का समय औपचारिक नियमों जितना ही मायने रखता है।

segments.src: Even with general licenses, China retains the ability to slow or tighten approvals, which is why many manufacturers continue to look for alternative sources.
segments.tr: सामान्य लाइसेंस के बावजूद, चीन के पास अनुमोदन को धीमा या सख्त करने की क्षमता बरकरार है, यही कारण है कि कई निर्माता वैकल्पिक स्रोतों की तलाश जारी रखे हुए हैं।

segments.src: **On tariffs,** the United States has kept the reduced rates in place during the truce period, though other tariff actions, including sector-specific measures and legal challenges to the use of emergency powers for tariffs, have continued to shape the broader picture.
segments.tr: **टैरिफ पर,** संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका ने युद्धविराम अवधि के दौरान कम दरों को लागू रखा है, हालांकि अन्य टैरिफ कार्रवाइयां, जिसमें क्षेत्र-विशिष्ट उपाय और टैरिफ के लिए आपातकालीन शक्तियों के उपयोग को कानूनी चुनौतियां शामिल हैं, व्यापक तस्वीर को आकार देना जारी रखे हुए हैं।

segments.src: ## What remains unresolved
segments.tr: ## क्या अनसुलझा है

segments.src: Several issues were deliberately left for later:
segments.tr: कई मुद्दों को जानबूझकर बाद के लिए छोड़ दिया गया था:

segments.src: 1. **Technology controls.** Restrictions on advanced semiconductors and chipmaking equipment remain a central point of friction. Each side's decisions in this area can trigger responses elsewhere.
segments.tr: 1. **प्रौद्योगिकी नियंत्रण।** उन्नत अर्धचालकों (semiconductors) और चिप बनाने वाले उपकरणों पर प्रतिबंध घर्षण का एक केंद्रीय बिंदु बने हुए हैं। इस क्षेत्र में प्रत्येक पक्ष के निर्णय कहीं और प्रतिक्रियाओं को ट्रिगर कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: 2. **Structural concerns.** U.S. officials continue to raise questions about industrial subsidies, overcapacity and market access. Chinese officials point to U.S. tariffs and export restrictions as barriers to normal trade.
segments.tr: 2. **संरचनात्मक चिंताएं।** अमेरिकी अधिकारी औद्योगिक सब्सिडी, अधिक क्षमता और बाजार पहुंच के बारे में सवाल उठाना जारी रखे हुए हैं। चीनी अधिकारी सामान्य व्यापार में बाधाओं के रूप में अमेरिकी टैरिफ और निर्यात प्रतिबंधों की ओर इशारा करते हैं।

segments.src: 3. **Legal uncertainty.** Court rulings on the authority behind some U.S. tariffs could change the tools available to the administration, even if the political deal holds.
segments.tr: 3. **कानूनी अनिश्चितता।** कुछ अमेरिकी टैरिफ के पीछे के अधिकार पर अदालती फैसले प्रशासन के लिए उपलब्ध उपकरणों को बदल सकते हैं, भले ही राजनीतिक समझौता कायम रहे।

segments.src: 4. **Durability.** A one-year arrangement invites a recurring cliff. Companies must decide whether to treat the current rates as a stable base or as a temporary window.
segments.tr: 4. **स्थायित्व।** एक साल की व्यवस्था एक आवर्ती संकट को आमंत्रित करती है। कंपनियों को यह तय करना होगा कि मौजूदा दरों को एक स्थिर आधार के रूप में माना जाए या एक अस्थायी अवसर के रूप में।

segments.src: ## Scenarios: extension, breakdown or something in between
segments.tr: ## परिदृश्य: विस्तार, टूटना या बीच का कुछ

segments.src: **Extension or a broader follow-up deal.** If both governments prolong the pause, the most likely effect is continuity: current tariff levels stay roughly in place, rare-earth licensing continues, and importers keep planning around today's costs.
segments.tr: **विस्तार या व्यापक अनुवर्ती समझौता।** यदि दोनों सरकारें विराम को लंबा करती हैं, तो सबसे संभावित प्रभाव निरंतरता है: वर्तमान टैरिफ स्तर मोटे तौर पर लागू रहते हैं, दुर्लभ-पृथ्वी लाइसेंसिंग जारी रहती है, और आयातक आज की लागत के आधार पर योजना बनाना जारी रखते हैं।

segments.src: A longer horizon would make it easier for businesses to commit to inventory and sourcing decisions, though it would not erase the tariffs that already exist.
segments.tr: एक लंबी समय सीमा व्यवसायों के लिए इन्वेंट्री और सोर्सिंग निर्णयों के लिए प्रतिबद्ध होना आसान बना देगी, हालांकि यह उन टैरिफ को नहीं मिटाएगी जो पहले से मौजूद हैं।

segments.src: **Partial lapse or selective tightening.** A middle path could involve some measures returning while others are kept in place.
segments.tr: **आंशिक चूक या चयनात्मक सख्ती।** एक बीच का रास्ता यह हो सकता है कि कुछ उपाय वापस आ जाएं जबकि अन्य लागू रहें।

segments.src: This would likely produce uneven effects across industries.
segments.tr: इससे उद्योगों पर असमान प्रभाव पड़ने की संभावना है।

segments.src: Sectors reliant on rare-earth inputs or on specific agricultural exports would be especially sensitive.
segments.tr: दुर्लभ-पृथ्वी इनपुट या विशिष्ट कृषि निर्यात पर निर्भर क्षेत्र विशेष रूप से संवेदनशील होंगे।

segments.src: **Breakdown.** If suspended measures snapped back, the effects would likely appear first in sentiment and shipping decisions, then in prices.
segments.tr: **टूटना।** यदि निलंबित उपाय वापस लागू हो जाते हैं, तो प्रभाव सबसे पहले भावना और शिपिंग निर्णयों में दिखाई देंगे, फिर कीमतों में।

segments.src: Higher tariffs usually raise costs for importers, who may absorb them, pass them to consumers or change suppliers.
segments.tr: उच्च टैरिफ आमतौर पर आयातकों के लिए लागत बढ़ाते हैं, जो उन्हें अवशोषित कर सकते हैं, उपभोक्ताओं पर डाल सकते हैं या आपूर्तिकर्ता बदल सकते हैं।

segments.src: Renewed rare-earth restrictions could affect production schedules for magnets and related components, with delays reaching manufacturers months later.
segments.tr: नवीनीकृत दुर्लभ-पृथ्वी प्रतिबंध चुम्बकों और संबंधित घटकों के लिए उत्पादन कार्यक्रम को प्रभावित कर सकते हैं, जिसमें देरी निर्माताओं तक महीनों बाद पहुंचेगी।

segments.src: Farmers would face renewed uncertainty about one of their largest export markets.
segments.tr: किसानों को अपने सबसे बड़े निर्यात बाजारों में से एक के बारे में नई अनिश्चितता का सामना करना पड़ेगा।

segments.src: ## What it means for prices and supply chains
segments.tr: ## कीमतों और आपूर्ति श्रृंखलाओं के लिए इसका क्या अर्थ है

segments.src: - **Consumers.** Tariff costs are only one part of retail prices, and effects vary by product. Categories with high import shares from China, such as some electronics, appliances and toys, are more exposed to rate changes than others.
segments.tr: - **उपभोक्ता।** टैरिफ लागत खुदरा कीमतों का केवल एक हिस्सा है, और प्रभाव उत्पाद के अनुसार भिन्न होते हैं। चीन से उच्च आयात हिस्सेदारी वाली श्रेणियां, जैसे कि कुछ इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स, उपकरण और खिलौने, दूसरों की तुलना में दर परिवर्तनों के प्रति अधिक संवेदनशील हैं।

segments.src: - **Manufacturers.** Many firms have spent the past year diversifying suppliers, building inventory buffers or shifting some assembly to other countries. These adjustments reduce but do not eliminate exposure, particularly for specialized inputs where few alternatives exist.
segments.tr: - **निर्माता।** कई फर्मों ने पिछले एक साल आपूर्तिकर्ताओं में विविधता लाने, इन्वेंट्री बफर बनाने या कुछ असेंबली को अन्य देशों में स्थानांतरित करने में बिताया है। ये समायोजन जोखिम को कम करते हैं लेकिन समाप्त नहीं करते हैं, विशेष रूप से उन विशेष इनपुट के लिए जहां बहुत कम विकल्प मौजूद हैं।

segments.src: - **Farmers and agribusiness.** Soybean prices and export demand are sensitive to Chinese buying. Steady purchases support farm incomes, while disruptions tend to push growers toward other markets and lower-priced sales.
segments.tr: - **किसान और कृषि व्यवसाय।** सोयाबीन की कीमतें और निर्यात मांग चीनी खरीद के प्रति संवेदनशील हैं। स्थिर खरीद कृषि आय का समर्थन करती है, जबकि व्यवधान उत्पादकों को अन्य बाजारों और कम कीमत वाली बिक्री की ओर धकेलते हैं।

segments.src: - **Investors and businesses.** Currency movements, shipping rates and commodity prices often react to trade headlines. Long-term planning typically depends less on any single announcement than on whether rules appear stable.
segments.tr: - **निवेशक और व्यवसाय।** मुद्रा की चाल, शिपिंग दरें और कमोडिटी की कीमतें अक्सर व्यापारिक सुर्खियों पर प्रतिक्रिया करती हैं। दीर्घकालिक योजना आमतौर पर किसी एक घोषणा पर कम निर्भर करती है और इस पर अधिक कि क्या नियम स्थिर दिखाई देते हैं।

segments.src: ## The bottom line

segments.src: The truce bought time rather than a settlement.
segments.tr: युद्धविराम ने समाधान के बजाय समय खरीदा।

segments.src: Its first year showed that both governments can lower tensions when they choose to, and that the arrangement depends on follow-through that is hard to measure from outside.
segments.tr: इसके पहले वर्ष ने दिखाया कि दोनों सरकारें जब चाहें तनाव कम कर सकती हैं, और यह व्यवस्था उस अनुवर्ती कार्रवाई पर निर्भर करती है जिसे बाहर से मापना मुश्किल है।

segments.src: Whether it is extended, rebuilt or allowed to expire, the outcome will shape costs and planning for households, farms and factories well beyond the two capitals involved.
segments.tr: चाहे इसे बढ़ाया जाए, फिर से बनाया जाए या समाप्त होने दिया जाए, परिणाम शामिल दोनों राजधानियों से परे परिवारों, खेतों और कारखानों के लिए लागत और योजना को आकार देगा।

vi.title: Một năm sau thỏa thuận đình chiến: Điều gì đang bị đe dọa trong sự hòa hoãn thương mại Mỹ-Trung

segments.src: When President Donald Trump and President Xi Jinping met in Busan, South Korea, on October 30, 2025, the two sides agreed to a one-year pause in several of their sharpest trade measures.
segments.tr: Khi Tổng thống Donald Trump và Chủ tịch Tập Cận Bình gặp nhau tại Busan, Hàn Quốc, vào ngày 30 tháng 10 năm 2025, hai bên đã đồng ý tạm dừng một năm đối với một số biện pháp thương mại gay gắt nhất của họ.

segments.src: The arrangement took effect in November 2025.
segments.tr: Thỏa thuận này có hiệu lực từ tháng 11 năm 2025.

segments.src: Now that the first anniversary has passed, attention has turned to a simple question: **will the pause be extended, reshaped, or allowed to lapse?**
segments.tr: Giờ đây, khi kỷ niệm một năm đã trôi qua, sự chú ý đã chuyển sang một câu hỏi đơn giản: **liệu lệnh tạm dừng này sẽ được gia hạn, định hình lại hay để mặc cho hết hiệu lực?**

segments.src: This article summarizes what the truce covered, what each side has done under it, which issues remain open, and how different outcomes could affect prices and supply chains.
segments.tr: Bài viết này tóm tắt những gì thỏa thuận đình chiến bao gồm, những gì mỗi bên đã thực hiện theo thỏa thuận đó, những vấn đề nào vẫn còn bỏ ngỏ và các kết quả khác nhau có thể ảnh hưởng đến giá cả và chuỗi cung ứng như thế nào.

segments.src: Trade policy changes quickly, so check official announcements for the latest status.
segments.tr: Chính sách thương mại thay đổi nhanh chóng, vì vậy hãy kiểm tra các thông báo chính thức để biết trạng thái mới nhất.

segments.src: ## Why the truce mattered
segments.tr: ## Tại sao thỏa thuận đình chiến lại quan trọng

segments.src: Through 2025, tariffs and export restrictions between the world's two largest economies escalated in steps.
segments.tr: Trong suốt năm 2025, thuế quan và các hạn chế xuất khẩu giữa hai nền kinh tế lớn nhất thế giới đã leo thang theo từng bước.

segments.src: Tariff rates on many goods climbed to levels that analysts warned could effectively halt trade in affected categories.
segments.tr: Mức thuế đối với nhiều loại hàng hóa đã tăng lên mức mà các nhà phân tích cảnh báo có thể làm đình trệ thương mại trong các danh mục bị ảnh hưởng.

segments.src: China also announced broader controls on rare-earth materials and related technologies, which are essential to magnets used in electric vehicles, wind turbines, electronics and defense equipment.
segments.tr: Trung Quốc cũng công bố các biện pháp kiểm soát rộng hơn đối với vật liệu đất hiếm và các công nghệ liên quan, vốn rất cần thiết cho nam châm được sử dụng trong xe điện, tuabin gió, thiết bị điện tử và thiết bị quốc phòng.

segments.src: The Busan arrangement did not resolve the underlying disagreements.
segments.tr: Thỏa thuận Busan không giải quyết được những bất đồng cơ bản.

segments.src: It lowered the temperature, giving businesses a more predictable window for planning.
segments.tr: Nó đã làm giảm nhiệt căng thẳng, mang lại cho các doanh nghiệp một khoảng thời gian dễ dự đoán hơn để lập kế hoạch.

segments.src: That predictability is the main thing at stake now.
segments.tr: Khả năng dự đoán đó là điều chính yếu đang bị đe dọa hiện nay.

segments.src: ## What the truce covered
segments.tr: ## Những gì thỏa thuận đình chiến bao gồm

segments.src: The main elements, as announced by both governments in late 2025, were:
segments.tr: Các yếu tố chính, như được cả hai chính phủ công bố vào cuối năm 2025, là:

segments.src: - **Tariffs.** The United States reduced the so-called fentanyl-related tariff on Chinese goods from 20% to 10% and extended a suspension of higher reciprocal tariff rates. Existing tariffs from earlier years, including Section 301 duties, largely remained in place.
segments.tr: - **Thuế quan.** Hoa Kỳ đã giảm mức thuế được gọi là liên quan đến fentanyl đối với hàng hóa Trung Quốc từ 20% xuống 10% và gia hạn việc đình chỉ các mức thuế đối ứng cao hơn. Các mức thuế hiện có từ những năm trước, bao gồm các khoản thuế Mục 301, phần lớn vẫn được giữ nguyên.

segments.src: - **Rare earths.** China agreed to suspend the sweeping export-control measures it announced in October 2025 and to issue general licenses for certain materials. Earlier licensing requirements introduced in April 2025 stayed in force, so the system was eased rather than removed.
segments.tr: - **Đất hiếm.** Trung Quốc đồng ý đình chỉ các biện pháp kiểm soát xuất khẩu sâu rộng mà họ đã công bố vào tháng 10 năm 2025 và cấp giấy phép chung cho một số vật liệu nhất định. Các yêu cầu cấp phép trước đó được đưa ra vào tháng 4 năm 2025 vẫn có hiệu lực, vì vậy hệ thống đã được nới lỏng thay vì bị loại bỏ.

segments.src: - **Agricultural purchases.** China committed to resume large-scale purchases of U.S. soybeans, with a stated target of about 12 million metric tons in late 2025 and 25 million metric tons annually in the following years.
segments.tr: - **Mua sắm nông sản.** Trung Quốc cam kết nối lại việc mua số lượng lớn đậu tương của Hoa Kỳ, với mục tiêu đã nêu là khoảng 12 triệu tấn vào cuối năm 2025 và 25 triệu tấn hàng năm trong những năm tiếp theo.

segments.src: - **Other pauses.** Both sides suspended some recently introduced measures, including certain port fees on ships and a U.S. rule that would have extended export restrictions to subsidiaries of listed companies.
segments.tr: - **Các lệnh tạm dừng khác.** Cả hai bên đã đình chỉ một số biện pháp mới được đưa ra gần đây, bao gồm một số loại phí cảng đối với tàu thuyền và quy định của Hoa Kỳ vốn sẽ mở rộng các hạn chế xuất khẩu sang các công ty con của các công ty niêm yết.

segments.src: ## What each side has delivered
segments.tr: ## Những gì mỗi bên đã thực hiện

segments.src: Assessing compliance is harder than it sounds, because the commitments were described in general terms and verification relies on trade data that is published with a delay.
segments.tr: Việc đánh giá sự tuân thủ khó hơn vẻ ngoài của nó, bởi vì các cam kết được mô tả bằng các thuật ngữ chung chung và việc xác minh dựa vào dữ liệu thương mại được công bố với độ trễ.

segments.src: **On soybeans,** the key metrics are monthly customs data and U.S.
segments.tr: **Về đậu tương,** các chỉ số chính là dữ liệu hải quan hàng tháng và báo cáo xuất khẩu của Bộ Nông nghiệp Hoa Kỳ.

segments.src: Department of Agriculture export reports.
segments.tr: Bộ Nông nghiệp Hoa Kỳ.

segments.src: Purchases are typically made by state-linked buyers, and timing follows seasonal patterns: the U.S.
segments.tr: Việc mua hàng thường được thực hiện bởi các bên mua liên kết với nhà nước, và thời điểm tuân theo các mô hình theo mùa: mùa thu hoạch và xuất khẩu của Hoa Kỳ

segments.src: harvest and export season runs mainly from autumn through winter, while Brazil dominates Chinese imports in the first half of the year.
segments.tr: chủ yếu diễn ra từ mùa thu đến mùa đông, trong khi Brazil thống trị nhập khẩu của Trung Quốc trong nửa đầu năm.

segments.src: Because of that seasonality, a full-year tally is more meaningful than any single month.
segments.tr: Do tính thời vụ đó, tổng số liệu cả năm có ý nghĩa hơn bất kỳ tháng đơn lẻ nào.

segments.src: Analysts have also noted that the 25-million-ton annual figure is below the volumes China bought from the United States in the years before the trade war, so meeting it would be a partial recovery, not a return to the old baseline.
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích cũng lưu ý rằng con số 25 triệu tấn hàng năm thấp hơn khối lượng Trung Quốc đã mua từ Hoa Kỳ trong những năm trước chiến tranh thương mại, vì vậy việc đạt được con số này sẽ là một sự phục hồi một phần, không phải là sự trở lại mức cơ sở cũ.

segments.src: **On rare earths,** the practical test is whether exporters can obtain licenses reliably and quickly.
segments.tr: **Về đất hiếm,** bài kiểm tra thực tế là liệu các nhà xuất khẩu có thể xin giấy phép một cách đáng tin cậy và nhanh chóng hay không.

segments.src: Companies in automotive and electronics supply chains have reported that approvals and delivery times matter as much as the formal rules.
segments.tr: Các công ty trong chuỗi cung ứng ô tô và điện tử đã báo cáo rằng thời gian phê duyệt và giao hàng quan trọng không kém các quy tắc chính thức.

segments.src: Even with general licenses, China retains the ability to slow or tighten approvals, which is why many manufacturers continue to look for alternative sources.
segments.tr: Ngay cả với giấy phép chung, Trung Quốc vẫn giữ khả năng làm chậm hoặc thắt chặt các phê duyệt, đó là lý do tại sao nhiều nhà sản xuất tiếp tục tìm kiếm các nguồn thay thế.

segments.src: **On tariffs,** the United States has kept the reduced rates in place during the truce period, though other tariff actions, including sector-specific measures and legal challenges to the use of emergency powers for tariffs, have continued to shape the broader picture.
segments.tr: **Về thuế quan,** Hoa Kỳ đã giữ nguyên các mức thuế giảm trong thời gian đình chiến, mặc dù các hành động thuế quan khác, bao gồm các biện pháp cụ thể theo ngành và các thách thức pháp lý đối với việc sử dụng quyền hạn khẩn cấp cho thuế quan, vẫn tiếp tục định hình bức tranh rộng lớn hơn.

segments.src: ## What remains unresolved
segments.tr: ## Những vấn đề vẫn chưa được giải quyết

segments.src: Several issues were deliberately left for later:
segments.tr: Một số vấn đề đã cố tình để lại sau:

segments.src: 1. **Technology controls.** Restrictions on advanced semiconductors and chipmaking equipment remain a central point of friction. Each side's decisions in this area can trigger responses elsewhere.
segments.tr: 1. **Kiểm soát công nghệ.** Các hạn chế đối với chất bán dẫn tiên tiến và thiết bị sản xuất chip vẫn là điểm ma sát trung tâm. Quyết định của mỗi bên trong lĩnh vực này có thể kích hoạt các phản ứng ở nơi khác.

segments.src: 2. **Structural concerns.** U.S. officials continue to raise questions about industrial subsidies, overcapacity and market access. Chinese officials point to U.S. tariffs and export restrictions as barriers to normal trade.
segments.tr: 2. **Mối quan ngại về cấu trúc.** Các quan chức Hoa Kỳ tiếp tục đặt câu hỏi về trợ cấp công nghiệp, tình trạng dư thừa công suất và tiếp cận thị trường. Các quan chức Trung Quốc chỉ ra các mức thuế và hạn chế xuất khẩu của Hoa Kỳ là rào cản đối với thương mại bình thường.

segments.src: 3. **Legal uncertainty.** Court rulings on the authority behind some U.S. tariffs could change the tools available to the administration, even if the political deal holds.
segments.tr: 3. **Sự không chắc chắn về pháp lý.** Các phán quyết của tòa án về thẩm quyền đằng sau một số mức thuế của Hoa Kỳ có thể thay đổi các công cụ có sẵn cho chính quyền, ngay cả khi thỏa thuận chính trị vẫn giữ nguyên.

segments.src: 4. **Durability.** A one-year arrangement invites a recurring cliff. Companies must decide whether to treat the current rates as a stable base or as a temporary window.
segments.tr: 4. **Độ bền.** Một thỏa thuận một năm mời gọi một vách đá tái diễn. Các công ty phải quyết định xem nên coi các mức thuế hiện tại là cơ sở ổn định hay là một khoảng thời gian tạm thời.

segments.src: ## Scenarios: extension, breakdown or something in between
segments.tr: ## Các kịch bản: gia hạn, đổ vỡ hoặc điều gì đó ở giữa

segments.src: **Extension or a broader follow-up deal.** If both governments prolong the pause, the most likely effect is continuity: current tariff levels stay roughly in place, rare-earth licensing continues, and importers keep planning around today's costs.
segments.tr: **Gia hạn hoặc một thỏa thuận tiếp theo rộng hơn.** Nếu cả hai chính phủ kéo dài thời gian tạm dừng, tác động có khả năng nhất là sự liên tục: các mức thuế hiện tại vẫn giữ nguyên, việc cấp phép đất hiếm tiếp tục và các nhà nhập khẩu tiếp tục lập kế hoạch xung quanh chi phí hiện nay.

segments.src: A longer horizon would make it easier for businesses to commit to inventory and sourcing decisions, though it would not erase the tariffs that already exist.
segments.tr: Một tầm nhìn dài hơn sẽ giúp các doanh nghiệp dễ dàng cam kết với các quyết định về hàng tồn kho và tìm nguồn cung ứng hơn, mặc dù nó sẽ không xóa bỏ các mức thuế đã tồn tại.

segments.src: **Partial lapse or selective tightening.** A middle path could involve some measures returning while others are kept in place.
segments.tr: **Hết hiệu lực một phần hoặc thắt chặt có chọn lọc.** Một con đường trung gian có thể bao gồm một số biện pháp quay trở lại trong khi những biện pháp khác được giữ nguyên.

segments.src: This would likely produce uneven effects across industries.
segments.tr: Điều này có khả năng tạo ra các tác động không đồng đều giữa các ngành.

segments.src: Sectors reliant on rare-earth inputs or on specific agricultural exports would be especially sensitive.
segments.tr: Các ngành phụ thuộc vào đầu vào đất hiếm hoặc vào xuất khẩu nông sản cụ thể sẽ đặc biệt nhạy cảm.

segments.src: **Breakdown.** If suspended measures snapped back, the effects would likely appear first in sentiment and shipping decisions, then in prices.
segments.tr: **Đổ vỡ.** Nếu các biện pháp bị đình chỉ quay trở lại, các tác động có khả năng xuất hiện đầu tiên trong tâm lý và các quyết định vận chuyển, sau đó là giá cả.

segments.src: Higher tariffs usually raise costs for importers, who may absorb them, pass them to consumers or change suppliers.
segments.tr: Thuế quan cao hơn thường làm tăng chi phí cho các nhà nhập khẩu, những người có thể hấp thụ chúng, chuyển chúng cho người tiêu dùng hoặc thay đổi nhà cung cấp.

segments.src: Renewed rare-earth restrictions could affect production schedules for magnets and related components, with delays reaching manufacturers months later.
segments.tr: Các hạn chế đất hiếm được gia hạn có thể ảnh hưởng đến lịch trình sản xuất nam châm và các thành phần liên quan, với sự chậm trễ đến với các nhà sản xuất vài tháng sau đó.

segments.src: Farmers would face renewed uncertainty about one of their largest export markets.
segments.tr: Nông dân sẽ phải đối mặt với sự không chắc chắn mới về một trong những thị trường xuất khẩu lớn nhất của họ.

segments.src: ## What it means for prices and supply chains
segments.tr: ## Điều đó có ý nghĩa gì đối với giá cả và chuỗi cung ứng

segments.src: - **Consumers.** Tariff costs are only one part of retail prices, and effects vary by product. Categories with high import shares from China, such as some electronics, appliances and toys, are more exposed to rate changes than others.
segments.tr: - **Người tiêu dùng.** Chi phí thuế quan chỉ là một phần của giá bán lẻ, và tác động khác nhau tùy theo sản phẩm. Các danh mục có tỷ trọng nhập khẩu cao từ Trung Quốc, chẳng hạn như một số thiết bị điện tử, đồ gia dụng và đồ chơi, dễ bị ảnh hưởng bởi thay đổi tỷ lệ hơn các danh mục khác.

segments.src: - **Manufacturers.** Many firms have spent the past year diversifying suppliers, building inventory buffers or shifting some assembly to other countries. These adjustments reduce but do not eliminate exposure, particularly for specialized inputs where few alternatives exist.
segments.tr: - **Nhà sản xuất.** Nhiều công ty đã dành năm qua để đa dạng hóa nhà cung cấp, xây dựng bộ đệm hàng tồn kho hoặc chuyển một phần lắp ráp sang các quốc gia khác. Những điều chỉnh này làm giảm nhưng không loại bỏ sự tiếp xúc, đặc biệt là đối với các đầu vào chuyên biệt nơi có ít lựa chọn thay thế.

segments.src: - **Farmers and agribusiness.** Soybean prices and export demand are sensitive to Chinese buying. Steady purchases support farm incomes, while disruptions tend to push growers toward other markets and lower-priced sales.
segments.tr: - **Nông dân và kinh doanh nông nghiệp.** Giá đậu tương và nhu cầu xuất khẩu nhạy cảm với việc mua hàng của Trung Quốc. Việc mua hàng ổn định hỗ trợ thu nhập trang trại, trong khi sự gián đoạn có xu hướng đẩy người trồng trọt sang các thị trường khác và doanh số bán hàng giá thấp hơn.

segments.src: - **Investors and businesses.** Currency movements, shipping rates and commodity prices often react to trade headlines. Long-term planning typically depends less on any single announcement than on whether rules appear stable.
segments.tr: - **Nhà đầu tư và doanh nghiệp.** Biến động tiền tệ, giá cước vận chuyển và giá hàng hóa thường phản ứng với các tiêu đề thương mại. Lập kế hoạch dài hạn thường phụ thuộc ít vào bất kỳ thông báo đơn lẻ nào hơn là việc liệu các quy tắc có vẻ ổn định hay không.

segments.src: ## What to watch next

segments.tr: Thỏa thuận đình chiến đã mua được thời gian thay vì một sự dàn xếp.

segments.src: Its first year showed that both governments can lower tensions when they choose to, and that the arrangement depends on follow-through that is hard to measure from outside.
segments.tr: Năm đầu tiên của nó cho thấy cả hai chính phủ có thể giảm căng thẳng khi họ chọn làm như vậy, và rằng thỏa thuận phụ thuộc vào việc thực hiện theo dõi vốn khó đo lường từ bên ngoài.

segments.src: Whether it is extended, rebuilt or allowed to expire, the outcome will shape costs and planning for households, farms and factories well beyond the two capitals involved.
